m.how: Sear an 800g eye fillet and brush with Dijon. Cook 400g finely chopped mushrooms until dry. Lay out 8 slices prosciutto, spread with mushrooms, roll the beef inside, then wrap in 2 sheets puff. Chill, egg wash and bake at 220C for 25 minutes to 52C. Rest 10 minutes.

w.note: Ice cream slab in a dark chocolate shell, sliced thick
w.how: Press 1L softened vanilla ice cream into a loaf tin lined with baking paper and freeze hard overnight. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 3 tbsp coconut oil. Turn out the slab, pour the chocolate over and let it set. Slice thick.

d.note: Frothy cinnamon hot chocolate with marshmallows
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, a pinch of salt and half a tsp cinnamon until frothy. Pour into four mugs and top each with a handful of marshmallows.

s.note: Chocolate pretzel rods rolled in crushed pretzel and sprinkles
s.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate. Dip 20 pretzel rods two-thirds of the way in. Roll in a mix of crushed pretzels and sprinkles and lay on baking paper to set. Stand them up in a tall glass to serve.

s.note: Honey mustard glazed turkey drumsticks to eat with your hands
s.how: Dissolve 80g salt and 80g brown sugar in 2L water and brine 4 turkey drumsticks overnight. Pat dry and roast at 160C for 90 minutes. Brush with 3 tbsp honey mixed with 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard for the last 15 minutes.

m.note: Smashed double cheeseburgers with burger sauce and chips
m.how: Mix 100g mayo, 2 tbsp relish and 1 tsp mustard for sauce. Smash 8 thin patties from 800g mince on a smoking griddle, add American cheese and stack two per toasted bun with pickles and sauce. Fry 1kg potato chips twice.

w.note: A shared trough of ice cream with every topping
w.how: Line a long dish with 4 split bananas. Add scoops of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream down the middle. Pile on whipped cream, chocolate sauce, sprinkles, chopped nuts and cherries. Give everyone a long spoon.

d.note: Cola poured slowly over vanilla ice cream
d.how: Put two scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Pour a 375ml can of cola slowly down the side of each so it foams up without spilling. Serve with long spoons and straws.

s.note: A mountain of homemade thin potato chips
s.how: Slice 6 potatoes thin on a mandoline, rinse and dry well. Fry at 170C in batches until golden and crisp. Salt well while hot. Make far more than seems sensible and pile them into a big bowl.

s.note: Puffy beer-battered onion rings, stacked like a six-pack
s.how: Cut 3 onions into thick rings and soak in 300ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip the rings in the batter and fry at 185C until puffed and golden. Salt and serve hot.

m.note: A platter stacked high with double cheeseburgers
m.how: Smash 12 thin patties from 1.2kg beef mince on a hot griddle, salt and flip after 90 seconds, adding American cheese. Stack two per toasted bun with pickles and onion, 6 burgers in total, and pile them on a platter.

w.note: Tall ice cream cones dipped in a chocolate shell
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 2 tbsp coconut oil and cool slightly. Pipe or scoop 1L softened vanilla ice cream high into 4 waffle cones. Freeze 20 minutes, then dip the tops in the chocolate so it sets into a shell.

d.note: A tub of ice packed with cold lager
d.how: Fill a big tub with a bag of ice and some water. Bury twelve 375ml cans of American lager for an hour. Consume mass quantities, responsibly.

s.note: Sliced grilled bratwurst under curry tomato sauce, with a bowl of fries
s.how: Grill 4 bratwurst slowly until browned, then slice. Soften 1 onion, add 3 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tsp curry powder, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp vinegar and 200ml water and simmer 10 minutes. Pour over and dust with curry powder. Serve with 600g potatoes fried as chips.

s.note: Warm gruyère choux puffs, crisp outside and hollow inside
s.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour and stir over heat for a minute. Cool slightly, beat in 2 eggs one at a time, then 80g grated gruyère and a little nutmeg. Pipe small rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

m.note: Sirloin with cognac peppercorn sauce and thin double-cooked fries
m.how: Dry-brine 4 sirloins overnight. Fry 1kg potatoes cut thin, at 140C then 185C. Sear the steaks hard in cast iron, pull at 54C and rest. In the pan, crush 1 tbsp peppercorns, flame 60ml brandy and add 200ml cream, then reduce until it coats a spoon.

w.note: Chocolate croissant pudding baked in a rich custard
w.how: Tear 6 stale croissants into a buttered dish and scatter with 100g chopped dark chocolate. Whisk 3 eggs, 300ml cream, 200ml milk and 60g sugar and pour over. Rest 20 minutes, then bake at 170C for 35 minutes until puffed and just set.

d.note: Cold junmai sake for Osaka, or warm cognac for Paris
d.how: Chill a 720ml bottle of junmai sake and pour into small cups for anyone on the Osaka side. For Paris, pour 30ml brandy into snifters and warm the glass in your hand before sipping. Let each guest pick a city.

s.note: Parmesan and black pepper popcorn in paper bags
s.how: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels, then add 120g kernels once they pop, cover and shake until the popping slows. Toss with 50g melted butter, 40g finely grated parmesan and plenty of cracked pepper. Fill four paper bags.

s.note: Blue and yellow corn chips with fresh tomato and lime salsa
s.how: Cut 6 blue corn and 6 yellow corn tortillas into wedges. Fry at 180C until crisp and salt. Dice 3 tomatoes and half an onion, mix with the juice of a lime and salt. Serve the chips mixed together with the salsa.

m.note: Smashed double cheeseburgers with burger sauce and chips
m.how: Mix 100g mayo, 2 tbsp relish and 1 tsp mustard for sauce. Smash 8 thin patties from 800g mince on a smoking griddle, add American cheese and stack two per toasted bun with pickles and sauce. Fry 1kg potato chips twice and salt.

w.note: Tall sundae with hot fudge, cream, sprinkles and a cherry
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Layer scoops of vanilla and chocolate ice cream in four tall glasses with the hot fudge. Finish with whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry on top.

d.note: Rich hot chocolate piled with marshmallows
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate until smooth and frothy. Pour into four mugs and top each with a handful of marshmallows, green and yellow ones if you can find them.

s.note: Popcorn coated half in purple, half in green white chocolate
s.how: Pop 100g kernels and split between two trays. Melt 200g white chocolate, divide in two and tint one half purple and the other green. Drizzle one over each tray and toss. Once set, break up and mix together in a big bowl.

s.n: Bat-shaped chips and black bean dip
s.note: Bat-shaped tortilla chips with smoky black bean dip
s.how: Cut 10 corn tortillas with a bat cutter and fry at 180C until crisp, then salt. Blitz 2 drained tins black beans with 2 garlic cloves, the juice of 2 limes and 1 chipotle in adobo until smooth. Serve the dip with the bats.

m.note: Slow-roasted rib of beef with Yorkshires, potatoes and jus
m.how: Salt a 2kg rib of beef overnight. Roast at 120C until 52C inside, rest, then blast at 260C for 10 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C for 20 minutes. Reduce 250ml red wine with 400ml stock for jus.

w.note: Chocolate cake in purple buttercream with a crooked green smile
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Beat 250g butter with 400g icing sugar, tint most purple and a little green. Cover and pipe a crooked smile.

d.note: Earl Grey in a warmed pot, poured into fine china
d.how: Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 4 Earl Grey tea bags and 1L freshly boiled water and steep 4 minutes. Pour into fine china cups with milk and lemon slices on the side.

s.note: Smoky spiced mix of pretzels, rice crackers, chickpeas and nuts
s.how: Toss 100g pretzels, 100g rice crackers, 100g roasted chickpeas and 150g mixed nuts with 50g melted butter, 1 tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp garlic powder, a pinch of chilli and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Bake at 150C for 25 minutes, stirring twice.

s.note: Grey meatballs in creamy mushroom sauce, each with a thumb dent
s.how: Roll 500g pork and beef mince into 20 balls and press a thumb dent into each. Bake at 220C for 15 minutes. Fry 200g sliced mushrooms, add 200ml stock, 150ml cream and 1 tbsp Dijon and simmer. Add the meatballs and simmer 5 minutes.

m.note: Pork sausage and roast pork wrapped in pita with peppery slaw
m.how: Grill 4 pork sausages and warm 300g sliced roast pork. Shred a quarter cabbage and a carrot and toss with mayo and lots of black pepper. Reduce a shallot, 150ml stock and 150ml cream with cracked pepper for sauce. Wrap everything tightly in 4 warm thick pitas.

w.note: Grey domed chocolate cake with a trench and crater
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in an ovenproof bowl at 170C for 50 minutes. Cover in 250g butter beaten with 400g icing sugar and a touch of black colouring. Pipe a trench and press a crater.

d.note: Pale blue pineapple and lime milk blended smooth
d.how: Blend 800ml cold milk with 200g frozen pineapple, the juice of a lime and half a tsp blue spirulina until smooth and pale blue. Add a little honey if you like it sweeter. Pour into four glasses straight away.

s.note: Crisp panko prawns with sweet chilli and lime
s.how: Butterfly 500g peeled green prawns. Dip in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 100g panko. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden. Drain and serve hot with sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges for squeezing.

s.note: Honey mint berries and cherries with whipped mascarpone
s.how: Toss 250g strawberries, halved, 125g blueberries and 200g pitted cherries with 1 tbsp honey and torn mint. Whip 250g mascarpone with another spoon of honey until soft. Serve the fruit in a bowl with the mascarpone alongside.

m.note: Honey thyme spatchcock chicken with roast root vegetables
m.how: Spatchcock a 1.8kg chicken and lay over 800g potatoes and 4 carrots cut into chunks. Roast at 220C for 40 minutes. Brush with 3 tbsp honey warmed with 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme for the last 10 minutes. Rest and pull apart to share.

w.note: Pistachio olive oil cake with matcha moss and berries
w.how: Blitz 150g pistachios fine. Whisk 3 eggs with 200g sugar, then 150ml olive oil, then fold in the pistachios and 150g self-raising flour. Bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Dust the top with 1 tsp matcha mixed with crumbs for moss and add berries.

d.note: Cold blue milk with pineapple and lime
d.how: Blend 800ml cold milk with 200g frozen pineapple, the juice of a lime and half a tsp blue spirulina until smooth and pale blue. Pour into four glasses and drink straight away, before the Ewoks get it.

s.note: Ham and gruyère toasties under bubbling béchamel, cut into fingers
s.how: Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 300ml milk and cook until thick. Spread 8 slices white bread with Dijon and béchamel, fill with 150g ham and half of 150g gruyère, close and top with the rest of the sauce and cheese. Bake at 200C until bubbling.

s.note: Crisp coiled filo pie of feta, ricotta and spinach
s.how: Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 200g feta, 200g ricotta and 2 eggs. Brush 8 sheets filo with 80g melted butter, spread filling along each, roll into ropes and coil in a round tin. Bake at 190C for 35 minutes and cut into wedges.

m.note: Tarragon roast chicken with white wine sauce and gratin
m.how: Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream and garlic and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Push 60g tarragon butter under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken and roast at 220C then 180C. Make a pan sauce with 150ml white wine. Serve with 300g green beans.

w.note: Silky vanilla custards turned out under amber caramel
w.how: Melt 150g sugar to amber caramel and pour into 4 ramekins. Whisk 4 eggs, 2 yolks, 100g sugar, 500ml milk and the seeds of a vanilla bean. Pour over and bake in a water bath at 150C for 40 minutes. Chill overnight and turn out.

d.note: Bordeaux red opened an hour early, poured into big glasses
d.how: Open a 750ml bottle of Bordeaux red an hour before dinner and let it breathe. Pour about 150ml into each of four big glasses, swirl, and keep the bottle on the table for top-ups.

s.note: Frozen sugared grapes with a little lime
s.how: Pick 500g grapes off the stem, wash and pat dry. Roll in the juice of a lime, then in 50g caster sugar. Spread on a lined tray and freeze for at least 3 hours. Serve straight from the freezer in a chilled bowl.

s.note: Coconut prawns with a fresh mango chilli dip
s.how: Butterfly 500g peeled green prawns, dip in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 60g panko mixed with 60g shredded coconut. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes. Blitz a mango with a little chilli and lime for the dip.

m.note: Glazed family meatloaf with mash and peas
m.how: Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk, then mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and a splash of Worcestershire. Shape in a loaf tin, glaze with tomato sauce and bake at 180C for an hour. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed and 300g peas.

w.note: A plain, perfect flourless chocolate torte with ganache
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick, fold in the chocolate and 100g almond meal. Bake at 160C for 35 minutes and cool. Pour over 100g chocolate melted with 100ml cream. No decoration, no capes.

d.note: Icy lemon slush blended with plenty of ice
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend with the juice of 5 lemons, 300ml cold water and 4 cups of ice until slushy. Pour into four glasses and serve with spoon straws.

s.note: Warm salted pretzels with a beer cheese dip
s.how: Brush 4 soft pretzels with butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Melt 150g sharp cheddar into 125g cream cheese and 100ml lager with 1 tsp mustard, stirring until smooth. Serve the dip warm.

s.note: Honey butter roasted nuts with thyme and sea salt
s.how: Toss 400g mixed nuts with 2 tbsp honey, 30g melted butter and chopped thyme. Roast at 170C for 12 minutes, stirring once. Sprinkle with flaky salt while warm and stir as they cool so they don't stick together.

m.note: Spiced yoghurt chicken in flatbread with garlic sauce and pickles
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 150g yoghurt, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp each cumin, coriander and paprika, a pinch of cinnamon and lemon juice overnight. Grill and slice. Serve in 4 warm flatbreads with garlic sauce, pickled turnips, tomato and parsley.

w.note: Round sugar cookies iced as red, white and blue shields
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Cut 12 rounds and bake at 180C for 9 minutes. Mix 300g icing sugar with water to a thick icing, tint some red and some blue, and ice rings with a blue centre and white star.

d.note: Honey lemon ginger beer, or real mead for grown-ups
d.how: Stir 1 tbsp honey and a squeeze of lemon into each of four glasses until dissolved. Fill with ice and top with ginger beer. For the grown-ups, pour 120ml chilled mead instead. Raise the glasses high.

s.note: Mini lattice apple pies baked in a muffin tin
s.how: Cook 3 diced apples with 3 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 8 minutes and cool. Line a 12-hole muffin tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust and fill. Top with strips of a third sheet in a lattice and bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

s.note: Crisp almond and orange biscotti for dunking
s.how: Mix 250g flour, 150g sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs, 100g almonds and the zest of an orange into a dough. Shape into a log and bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes, slice and bake again for 10 minutes a side.

m.note: Thick cheeseburgers wrapped in foil to stay warm
m.how: Shape 800g beef mince into 4 thick patties and griddle to medium. Melt cheddar on top under a lid. Put on toasted buns with sliced onion and pickles, then wrap each tightly in foil and rest 5 minutes so everything melds.

w.note: Double crust apple pie with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 1kg sliced Granny Smiths with 120g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp flour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill, cover with 2 more and egg wash. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Short, strong double espressos in small cups
d.how: Grind 72g espresso beans fine. For each cup, pull a double shot with 18g of coffee into a small warmed cup, about 40ml. Serve straight away, black, the beatnik way. A stovetop pot works if there's no machine.

s.note: Smoked salmon on dark rye with crème fraîche and capers
s.how: Butter 6 slices dark rye bread. Top with 200g smoked salmon, a spoon of crème fraîche, a few capers and dill sprigs. Cut into fingers with a sharp knife and serve cold on a dark plate.

s.note: Hot roasted chestnuts wrapped in a towel to peel
s.how: Cut a cross into 500g chestnuts and soak in water for 20 minutes. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes until the shells curl back. Wrap in a tea towel for 5 minutes, then peel warm and sprinkle with flaky salt.

m.note: Crackling pork loin with apple sage sauce and roast potatoes
m.how: Score a 1.5kg pork loin and dry uncovered overnight. Salt well and roast at 240C for 30 minutes, then 180C until 63C inside. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Cook 3 apples with sage and a little sugar to a chunky sauce.

w.note: White cupcakes topped with a tiny tree and coconut snow
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Ice with 150g butter beaten with 300g icing sugar, then add a sugar tree and shredded coconut snow.

d.note: Brandy milk punch shaken cold, with nutmeg
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml brandy, 90ml cold milk, 15ml sugar syrup and a drop of vanilla hard with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe and grate nutmeg over the top. Makes four.

s.note: Beer-battered fish tacos with cabbage and chipotle crema
s.how: Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 chipotle and lime juice. Serve in 12 warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, crema and lime wedges.

s.note: Lime and chilli roasted peanuts in foil packets
s.how: Toss 300g peanuts with the zest of 2 limes, 1 tsp chilli powder and flaky salt. Roast at 160C for 15 minutes, stirring once. Cool and fold into four little foil packets, like the snacks on the flight to Cabo.

m.note: Sirloin with a loaded baked potato and blue cheese wedge salad
m.how: Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for an hour. Sear 4 sirloins, pull at 54C and rest. Cut an iceberg into 4 wedges and spoon over 100g blue cheese mixed with sour cream. Load the potatoes with sour cream and chives.

w.note: Spiced sweet potato pie in a buttery crust
w.how: Roast 800g sweet potatoes until soft, peel and mash with 60g butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk and 1 tsp mixed spice. Pour into a blind-baked case of 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and bake at 170C for 50 minutes.

d.note: Vodka and fresh orange juice over ice
d.how: For each drink, fill a tall glass with ice, add 45ml vodka and top with about 150ml fresh orange juice. Stir and serve. Squeeze the oranges yourself if you've got time, it makes all the difference.

s.note: Tiny gruyère gougères filled with whipped goat's cheese
s.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour and cook a minute. Cool, beat in 2 eggs and 60g gruyère. Pipe small rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Split and fill with 120g goat's cheese whipped with chives.

s.note: Mini cornmeal deep dish pizzas with sausage and tomato
s.how: Knead 300g pizza dough with 2 tbsp cornmeal and press into a 12-hole mini muffin tin. Fill with diced mozzarella, crumbled sausage from 2 Italian sausages and chunky crushed tomato. Bake at 210C for 18 minutes until bubbling.

m.note: Grilled Italian sausages with peppers and onions in crusty rolls
m.how: Grill 8 Italian sausages slowly until browned. In the same pan, soften 2 sliced capsicums and 2 sliced onions in the fat with 1 tsp oregano. Pile the sausages and peppers into 4 long crusty rolls and add hot mustard.

w.note: Bright buttercream cupcakes with sprinkles and paper flags
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, tint bright colours, swirl on and top with sprinkles and a paper flag.

d.note: Lemonade with cherry syrup and maraschino cherries
d.how: Fill four tall glasses with ice. Add 2 tbsp syrup from a jar of maraschino cherries and a few cherries to each. Top with cold lemonade, about 250ml per glass, and stir until it turns cherry red.

s.note: Baked ham and Swiss sliders with honey mustard
s.how: Split 12 slider buns and spread with 2 tbsp honey mixed with 2 tbsp Dijon. Fill with 250g sliced ham and 150g Swiss cheese. Pack into a tray, cover with foil and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until melted.

s.note: Baked nachos splashed with lime crema and pickled onion
s.how: Quick-pickle a sliced red onion in lime juice and salt. Layer 300g corn chips with a drained tin of black beans and 200g cheddar and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Splash over 150g sour cream thinned with lime, then the onion and coriander.

m.note: Bacon double cheeseburger with onion rings and barbecue sauce
m.how: Soak a thick-sliced onion in milk, dredge in flour and fry into rings. Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Smash 8 patties from 800g mince with American cheese. Stack two per toasted bun with bacon, onion rings and barbecue sauce.

w.note: Big soft brown butter cookies with flaky salt
w.how: Brown 150g butter and cool. Beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour, half a tsp bicarb and 200g choc chips. Rest overnight. Scoop 10 big balls and bake at 180C for 11 minutes so the middles stay soft. Add flaky salt.

d.note: Sweet black iced tea with lemon
d.how: Steep 6 black tea bags in 1L just-boiled water for 5 minutes, then remove and stir in 80g sugar while hot. Chill completely. Pour over ice in four tall glasses with lemon slices.

s.note: Puffy beer-battered onion rings, crisp and golden
s.how: Cut 3 onions into thick rings and soak in 300ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip the rings in the batter and fry at 185C until puffed and golden. Salt and serve hot.

s.note: Coconut prawns with fresh pineapple salsa
s.how: Dip 400g peeled green prawns in flour, beaten egg and a mix of 60g shredded coconut and 60g panko. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes. Dice a quarter pineapple with red onion, chilli and lime for salsa. Serve together.

m.note: Pineapple soy glazed chicken with coconut rice
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 250ml pineapple juice, 60ml soy, grated ginger and 2 garlic cloves for 2 hours. Grill, then reduce the marinade to a glaze and brush over. Cook 300g jasmine rice in 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water.

w.note: Hot fudge sundae with a sparkler lit at the table
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream and a cherry. Push a sparkler into each and light it at the table.

d.note: Root beer in frosted mugs, a float for good flights
d.how: Freeze four mugs for 30 minutes. Pour a 375ml can of root beer into each. For anyone who had a good flight, add a scoop of vanilla ice cream and let it foam over.

s.note: A cardboard box of warm glazed and chocolate doughnuts
s.how: Warm 4 glazed and 4 chocolate doughnuts on a tray at 160C for 2 minutes until the glaze turns glossy. Pack them into a cardboard box lined with napkins and pass it around the couch.

s.note: Mini pepperoni pizzas, held up to the camera
s.how: Roll out 500g pizza dough and cut into 16 rounds. Spread each with pizza sauce, add grated mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni. Bake at 230C for 8 minutes. Present one to the camera with a cheesy grin before eating.

m.note: Pepperoni and mushroom pizza cut into squares
m.how: Stretch 500g dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce, add 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and 150g sliced mushrooms. Bake on a hot steel or tray at the oven's highest heat for 7 minutes and cut into squares.

w.note: Fried choux rings dipped in thin honey glaze
w.how: Boil 250ml water with 100g butter, beat in 150g flour and cook a minute. Cool, then beat in 4 eggs. Pipe rings onto squares of baking paper and fry at 180C, paper and all, until puffed. Dip in 200g icing sugar whisked with 2 tbsp honey and water.

d.note: Cola over ice, held at exactly the right angle
d.how: Fill four big glasses with ice and pour a 375ml can of cola into each. Hold the can beside your face with the label to camera, smile and say nothing. Then drink.

s.note: Smoked mackerel and horseradish pâté on toasted rye
s.how: Flake 250g smoked mackerel, removing the skin and bones. Blitz with 150g cream cheese, 1 tbsp horseradish, lemon juice and black pepper until mostly smooth. Spread on toasted rye and top with thin cucumber slices.

s.note: Golden sage and apple sausage rolls
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with 1 grated apple, 1 finely chopped onion and chopped sage. Lay along 2 sheets puff pastry, roll up, egg wash and cut into 16. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.

m.note: Beef and ale pie with thick chips and minted mushy peas
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck with 2 onions and thyme, add 375ml ale and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken, pour into a dish, cover with puff and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Fry 1kg thick chips twice. Crush 300g cooked peas with butter and mint.

w.note: Steamed currant pudding with hot custard
w.how: Rub 100g butter into 250g self-raising flour, stir in 75g sugar and 150g currants, then add 150ml milk to a soft dough. Press into a greased basin, cover with paper and foil and steam for 90 minutes. Turn out and serve with hot custard.

d.note: Pints of lager or ale with a packet of crisps
d.how: Chill four pint glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Pour 500ml lager or English ale into each, tilted at first. Put a packet of salted crisps next to every glass, like a proper pub.

s.note: Buttery salted popcorn, half of it caramel
s.how: Pop 120g kernels and toss with 30g melted butter and salt. Boil 100g brown sugar, 50g butter and 2 tbsp golden syrup for 4 minutes and pour over half. Bake that half at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15. Mix both together.

s.note: A paprika cheese ball shaped like a pumpkin, with crackers
s.how: Beat 200g grated sharp cheddar with 250g cream cheese, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp Worcestershire. Shape into a ball and chill an hour. Score lines like a pumpkin, roll in more paprika and push a capsicum stem on top. Serve with crackers.

m.note: Beef and bean chilli served in little roast pumpkins
m.how: Brown 800g beef mince with 1 onion and 2 tbsp chilli powder, add 2 tins tomatoes and 2 tins kidney beans and simmer 90 minutes. Hollow 4 small pumpkins and roast at 200C for 30 minutes. Fill with chilli, sour cream and cheddar.

w.note: Spiced pumpkin pie with a pale whipped cream mask
w.how: Roast 800g pumpkin, purée and whisk with 3 eggs, 150g brown sugar, 200ml cream and 2 tsp mixed spice. Pour into a blind-baked case of 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Cool and pipe a pale mask in whipped cream.

d.note: Spiced hot cloudy apple juice with cinnamon, cloves and orange
d.how: Simmer 1.5L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves and a few strips of orange peel for 15 minutes. Strain and ladle into four mugs while hot. Keep the porch light on.

s.note: Smoked salmon cucumber rounds and little ham quiches
s.how: Line a 12-hole tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust. Whisk 2 eggs with 150ml cream, add 80g diced ham and chives, fill and bake at 180C for 15 minutes. Top thick cucumber rounds with 150g smoked salmon.

s.note: Crisp pan-fried pork dumplings with soy and black vinegar
s.how: Fry 24 frozen pork dumplings flat side down in a little oil until golden. Add 100ml water, cover and steam 4 minutes. Uncover and crisp again. Mix soy and black vinegar with sliced spring onion to dip.

m.note: Chicken braised in white wine, mushrooms and cream, with pilaf
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs. Add 250g mushrooms, thyme and 200ml white wine and braise 35 minutes, then stir in 100ml cream. Cook 300g long grain rice with a knob of butter and 600ml stock for pilaf.

w.note: Pink strawberry buttercream layer cake with sixteen candles
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Blitz 150g strawberries and beat into 250g butter with 450g icing sugar. Fill, cover and add exactly sixteen candles.

d.note: Pineapple, orange and cranberry punch with lemonade
d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice, 500ml orange juice and 250ml cranberry juice into a punch bowl with ice. Top with 750ml lemonade and float a sliced orange on top. Ladle into cups.

s.note: Chewy honey peanut butter oat and puffed rice bars
s.how: Melt 60g butter, 80g honey and 100g peanut butter together. Stir through 150g rolled oats and 80g puffed rice cereal until coated. Press firmly into a lined tin, chill for 2 hours and cut into bars.

s.note: Frozen lime-sugared red and green grapes
s.how: Pick 250g red and 250g green grapes off the stem, wash and dry. Roll in the juice of a lime, then in 50g caster sugar. Spread on a tray and freeze for at least 3 hours until solid. Serve straight from the freezer.

m.note: Chips, cheese curds and hot beef gravy
m.how: Fry 1kg potatoes cut into chips, at 140C then 185C. Cook 40g butter with 3 tbsp flour for 2 minutes, then whisk in 500ml beef stock and simmer until thick. Pile chips into bowls, scatter 250g cheese curds and pour the hot gravy over.

w.note: Hard-frozen vanilla ice cream under a setting chocolate shell
w.how: Put four bowls in the freezer for an hour. Scoop 1L very hard vanilla ice cream into them. Melt 150g dark chocolate with 2 tbsp coconut oil and pour over at the table, so it sets into a shell in seconds.

d.note: Ice-cold Canadian lager from the bottle, no glass
d.how: Chill eight 355ml bottles of Canadian lager for at least three hours. Hand them out with the caps off. No glasses, no conversation, just drink it.

s.note: Golden cornmeal-battered corn dogs on sticks, with yellow mustard
s.how: Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep golden. Serve with mustard.

s.note: A box of chips, pretzels and lollies for the back seat
s.how: Tip a big bag of potato chips, 200g pretzels and 300g mixed lollies into a cardboard box lined with paper. Pass it into the back seat and try to make it last longer than the first hour of the drive.

m.note: Sticky burnt ends glazed in sweet barbecue sauce
m.how: Cut a 1.5kg brisket point into 4cm cubes and rub with smoked paprika and salt. Roast at 140C for 3 hours. Toss with 200ml barbecue sauce and 2 tbsp brown sugar and return to the oven for 30 minutes until sticky.

w.note: Red toffee apples with fairy floss on the side
w.how: Push sticks into 4 apples. Boil 400g sugar, 125ml water and 1 tsp vinegar to 150C, then add a few drops of red colouring. Dip and twirl the apples and set on baking paper. Serve with a bag of fairy floss.

d.note: Fresh lemonade in a big thermos packed with ice
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water. Pour into a big thermos packed with ice and drink it from cups in the car.

s.note: Iced prawns in martini glasses with a sharp horseradish cocktail sauce
s.how: Poach 500g green prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel. Mix 125ml tomato sauce, 1 tbsp horseradish, lemon juice and a dash of Worcestershire. Serve over shredded iceberg in martini glasses with lemon wedges.

s.note: Paper-thin homemade chips with truffle salt and parmesan
s.how: Slice 600g potatoes paper thin on a mandoline, rinse and dry very well. Fry at 170C in batches until golden. Toss straight away with truffle salt and 30g finely grated parmesan so it sticks. Serve in a silver bowl.

m.note: Steakhouse rib eye with béarnaise and creamed spinach
m.how: Dry-brine 4 rib eyes overnight. Reduce 60ml white wine vinegar with tarragon and shallot, whisk with 3 yolks and drizzle in 200g warm clarified butter. Wilt 500g spinach, squeeze and simmer in 200ml cream. Sear the steaks, pull at 54C and rest.

w.note: Tall hot fudge sundaes with cream and gold sprinkles
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses and pour over the fudge. Pipe whipped cream high and scatter gold sprinkles so they catch the light.

d.note: Stirred gin martini with a green olive
d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth over plenty of ice for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into a chilled martini glass and add a green olive on a pick. Makes four.

s.note: Double-fried wings in a sticky gochujang honey glaze
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings in 100g potato starch. Fry at 160C for 8 minutes, rest 5, then fry at 190C until very crisp. Simmer 2 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 3 tbsp honey and 2 crushed garlic cloves until glossy. Toss and scatter with sesame seeds.

s.note: Chewy rice cakes in a glossy red chilli sauce
s.how: Soak 500g rice cakes in water for 20 minutes. Simmer 500ml stock made with a few dried anchovies, then add 2 tbsp gochujang, 1 tbsp gochugaru and 1 tbsp sugar. Add the rice cakes and 150g sliced fish cake and simmer until thick and glossy. Top with spring onion.

m.note: Crispy-bottomed kimchi fried rice with a fried egg on top
m.how: Fry 150g chopped bacon until crisp, then add 300g chopped kimchi and a splash of its juice. Add 4 cups cold cooked rice from 300g jasmine rice, 1 tbsp gochujang and 30g butter, and press flat to crisp the bottom. Top each bowl with a fried egg and torn nori.

w.note: Pan-fried sweet pancakes with melted brown sugar inside
w.how: Mix 300g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar and 220ml warm water and rest an hour. Mix 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 40g chopped peanuts. Fill 8 balls of dough with the mix, seal and press flat in an oiled pan. Fry until golden and the sugar melts inside.

d.note: Sweet cold banana milk, blended and strained
d.how: Blend 2 ripe bananas with 1L cold full cream milk, 1 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt until smooth. Strain through a sieve for a silky drink. Chill well and pour into four glasses.

s.note: Crisp homemade tater tots with a soft middle
s.how: Parboil 800g potatoes for 8 minutes, cool and grate. Squeeze dry and season with salt and 1 tsp onion powder. Shape into little cylinders and freeze 30 minutes. Fry at 180C until golden and crisp all over.

s.note: Crunchy cornflake chicken nuggets with honey mustard
s.how: Cut 600g chicken breast into nuggets and soak in 250ml buttermilk for an hour. Dredge in flour, then crushed corn flakes. Fry at 175C for 4 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp Dijon for dipping.

m.note: Golden cheese quesadillas with salsa and sour cream
m.how: Fill 8 flour tortillas with 150g grated cheddar and 150g Monterey Jack, then fold in half. Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted. Serve with diced tomato salsa and sour cream.

w.note: A dome cake that spills lollies when cut
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Bake in an ovenproof bowl at 170C for 50 minutes. Hollow the centre, fill with 200g lollies and cover with 400g icing sugar beaten with 250g butter in bright stripes.

d.note: Cold milk, or chocolate milk for the dance
d.how: Pour 1L cold full cream milk into four tall glasses. For chocolate milk, whisk 3 tbsp cocoa and 3 tbsp sugar into a splash of hot milk first, then stir it through. Drink it like a champion.

s.note: Garlic rosemary cannellini on sourdough, a cold tin on the side
s.how: Warm 2 drained tins cannellini beans in 3 tbsp olive oil with 2 sliced garlic cloves, rosemary and chilli flakes, crushing a few. Pile onto grilled sourdough. Put one cold tin of baked beans and a spoon on the side for authenticity.

s.note: Brown butter honey popcorn baked crisp
s.how: Pop 120g kernels. Cook 60g butter until golden and nutty, stir in 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of flaky salt. Pour over the popcorn, toss, spread on a tray and bake at 150C for 10 minutes until crisp.

m.note: Creamy chicken curry with basmati rice
m.how: Soften 1 onion with 2 tbsp grated ginger and 3 garlic cloves. Add 2 tsp garam masala and a tin of tomatoes, then 1kg diced chicken thighs, and simmer 30 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream. Serve with 300g basmati rice and naan.

w.note: Yellow smiley face cookies with a splash of jam
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Roll to 5mm, cut rounds and bake at 180C for 9 minutes. Ice yellow with 300g icing sugar, pipe two eyes and a smile in black and add a drop of strawberry jam.

d.note: Big mugs of drip coffee with milk
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine. Pour into big mugs with milk. Drink it at the kitchen table without talking about the old days.

s.note: Golden cornmeal hush puppies with hot sauce butter
s.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp sugar, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and 200ml buttermilk. Drop spoonfuls into 175C oil and fry until golden. Melt 60g butter with 2 tbsp hot sauce for dipping.

s.note: Hot roasted peanuts with salt and cayenne in a tin bucket
s.how: Spread 400g peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 20 minutes. Toss straight away with fine salt and a pinch of cayenne. Tip into a tin bucket, behind chicken wire if you can manage it.

m.note: A big pile of buttermilk fried chicken
m.how: Brine 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tbsp hot sauce. Dredge twice in 300g flour seasoned with salt and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Fry at 165C until 74C inside, about 14 minutes. Pile them high on a platter.

w.note: Double crust apple pie with cream on the side
w.how: Toss 1kg sliced Granny Smiths with 120g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp flour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill, cover with 2 more and egg wash. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve with 300ml cream.

d.note: Ice-cold cola in glass bottles with straws
d.how: Chill four glass bottles of cola in the fridge for at least three hours. Pop the caps, drop a straw into each and serve alongside the chicken.

s.note: Warm anchovy and garlic dip with raw vegetables and bread
s.how: Melt 60g butter in 150ml olive oil over very low heat with 8 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tin anchovies until the anchovies dissolve. Keep warm over a candle. Dip sliced fennel, red capsicum, radishes and bread.

s.note: Golden cheese toasts cut like gold bars
s.how: Mix 150g grated vintage cheddar, 30g parmesan, 1 tsp English mustard and 1 egg. Cut 6 slices of bread into neat bars and toast one side. Spread the cheese mix on the other side and grill until golden and bubbling.

m.note: Thin cold pork loin under a creamy tuna caper sauce
m.how: Poach an 800g pork loin gently in salted water for 45 minutes until 63C inside, then chill. Blitz a 185g tin of tuna, 3 anchovies, 1 tbsp capers, 150g mayo and lemon juice until smooth. Slice the pork thin and cover with the sauce and more capers.

w.note: Piedmont chocolate amaretti custard under dark caramel
w.how: Cook 150g sugar to a dark caramel and pour into a loaf tin. Whisk 4 eggs, 100g sugar, 500ml milk, 2 tbsp cocoa, 80g crushed amaretti and 2 tbsp dark rum. Pour over and bake in a water bath at 160C for 45 minutes. Chill and turn out.

d.note: A short espresso with sugar, drunk standing up
d.how: Brew a short espresso for each person using 18g finely ground coffee, in a machine or stovetop pot. Stir in a spoon of sugar and drink it in two sips standing at the bench, the Italian way.

s.note: Tiny crustless squares of egg, cucumber and ham, stood up neatly
s.how: Boil 3 eggs and mash with mayo and cress. Make sandwiches of egg, cucumber with 100g cream cheese, and 100g ham with Dijon, using 12 slices white bread. Cut off the crusts and cut into exact little squares. Stand them up in rows.

s.note: Nut-free seeds, dried cherries and dark chocolate
s.how: Toss 100g pumpkin seeds, 100g sunflower seeds, 100g dried cherries and 100g dark chocolate chunks with a pinch of salt. Check every packet says nut-free. Serve in a bowl.

m.note: Chicken, mushroom and leek pie under puff pastry
m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then soften 250g mushrooms and 2 sliced leeks. Add 150ml white wine and 200ml cream and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Tip into a dish, cover with puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: Dark chocolate cake with ganache, every label checked for nuts
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 4 eggs with 200g sugar, fold in the chocolate and 100g flour. Bake at 170C for 35 minutes. Pour over 100g chocolate melted with 100ml cream. Check every label for nuts first.

d.note: Medium-bodied Shiraz opened early, with mineral water
d.how: Open a 750ml bottle of Shiraz half an hour before dinner. Serve just under room temperature, about 150ml a glass. Put a bottle of mineral water on the table too.

s.note: Toasted marshmallows with chocolate between biscuits
s.how: Toast 16 big marshmallows on sticks over the fire or a gas flame until blistered. Dip in 100g melted dark chocolate and squash between 2 digestive biscuits, 32 biscuits in all. Eat while still gooey.

s.note: Ham and cheddar with mustard and pickles, wrapped in wax paper
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread and spread with mustard. Fill with 200g ham, 100g sliced cheddar and a few pickles. Cut in half and wrap each tightly in wax paper, ready for the walk.

m.note: Thick diner cheeseburger with onion and pickles
m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 thick patties and season at the last moment. Griddle to medium and melt cheddar on top under a lid. Serve on toasted buns with sliced onion and pickles.

w.note: Lattice blueberry pie, cooled before slicing
w.how: Toss 750g blueberries with 150g sugar, the juice of a lemon and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and cool 3 hours.

d.note: Glass bottle colas chilled in an esky
d.how: Fill an esky with ice and cold water and sink four glass bottles of cola for an hour. Pop the caps and drink them by the tracks.

s.note: Tuna poke on crisp wonton squares with avocado
s.how: Fry 16 wonton wrappers at 180C until crisp. Dice 250g sashimi tuna and dress with 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, lime juice and spring onion. Spoon onto the wontons, add a dot of smashed avocado and toasted sesame.

s.note: Blistered yoghurt flatbreads with garlic butter and hummus
s.how: Mix 300g flour, 250g Greek yoghurt, 1 tsp baking powder and salt to a soft dough. Roll into 6 thin rounds and cook in a dry hot pan until blistered. Brush with 50g butter melted with garlic. Serve with a tub of hummus.

m.note: Butter-basted rib eye with chimichurri and crispy baby potatoes
m.how: Dry-brine 4 rib eyes. Roast 800g halved baby potatoes at 220C for 35 minutes. Sear the steaks and baste with 40g butter. Chop parsley, 1 tsp oregano, 2 garlic cloves and a chilli with 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml oil. Spoon over.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes piped with a glowing blue reactor ring
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, tint half blue, pipe a blue ring with a white centre.

d.note: Single malt over one big clear cube
d.how: Put one big clear ice cube in each of four heavy tumblers. Pour 45ml single malt Scotch over each and swirl. Sip it slowly, like you own the bottle.

s.note: Cheese sliders with mayo, the European way
s.how: Smash 12 small patties from 500g beef mince on a hot griddle, salt and flip, adding American cheese. Put on soft slider buns with diced onion, pickle, mustard and a dab of mayo, the way they do it in Amsterdam.

s.note: Thin fries in red-checked paper boats with sauce
s.how: Cut 1kg russets into thin fries and soak an hour, then dry well. Fry at 140C for 5 minutes, rest, then at 190C until crisp. Salt and serve in red-checked paper boats with tomato sauce and mustard.

m.note: Teriyaki burger with grilled pineapple and cheddar
m.how: Simmer 60ml soy, 60ml mirin and 2 tbsp brown sugar until syrupy. Grill 4 pineapple rings until charred. Grill 4 thick chuck patties, brushing with the teriyaki, then melt cheddar on top. Build on toasted buns with lettuce and pineapple.

w.note: Buttermilk pancake stacks with maple and crisp bacon
w.how: Whisk 300g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 tbsp sugar, 500ml buttermilk and 2 eggs and rest 15 minutes. Cook in butter until bubbles set. Grill 8 rashers of bacon until crisp. Stack the pancakes with butter and maple syrup and bacon on the side.

d.note: Thick vanilla shake worth every one of the five dollars
d.how: For each shake, blend 3 scoops vanilla bean ice cream with 120ml cold milk until just thick enough for a straw to stand up. Pour into a chilled glass, top with whipped cream and a cherry. Makes four.

s.note: Little yeasted blini with crème fraîche, roe and chives
s.how: Mix 150g buckwheat flour, 7g yeast and 250ml warm milk and rest an hour. Cook small spoonfuls in butter until golden. Top each with crème fraîche, salmon roe and snipped chives. Serve beside frozen vodka.

s.note: Soft baked buns with beef, onion and dill
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 250ml warm milk and 30g butter into a soft dough and prove an hour. Fry 400g beef mince with an onion and dill and cool. Fill 12 rounds, seal and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Brush with butter.

m.note: Seared beef in brandy mushroom sour cream over egg noodles
m.how: Sear 600g beef fillet strips fast and set aside. Cook 300g mushrooms and an onion in 30g butter, add 1 tsp paprika and flame 30ml brandy. Add 200ml stock, then stir in 200g sour cream off the heat and return the beef. Serve over 400g buttered egg noodles.

w.note: Layered honey cake with sour cream frosting, rested overnight
w.how: Melt 100g honey, 100g butter and 150g sugar, whisk in 3 eggs and 1 tsp bicarb, then 450g flour. Roll into 8 thin discs and bake each 6 minutes at 180C. Layer with 600g sour cream beaten with 395g condensed milk and coat in crumbs.

d.note: Shaken vodka martini with lemon peel
d.how: For each drink, shake 60ml vodka and 10ml dry vermouth hard with ice. Strain into a chilled martini glass and twist a strip of lemon peel over the top. Makes four.

s.note: Twisted parmesan pastry straws with paprika and cayenne
s.how: Brush 2 sheets puff pastry with beaten egg. Cover one with 80g grated parmesan, a pinch of paprika and cayenne, lay the other on top and press. Cut into strips, twist and bake at 200C for 12 minutes.

s.note: Slow-baked molasses beans on buttered toast
s.how: Soak 300g navy beans overnight, then simmer 30 minutes. Bake at 150C for 4 hours with 150g diced speck, an onion, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tsp mustard powder and enough water to cover. Spoon onto buttered sourdough toast.

m.note: Creamy clam chowder with bacon, potato and thyme
m.how: Steam 1kg clams open in 125ml white wine and strain the liquid. Render 150g bacon, add an onion, 2 celery sticks and 500g diced potato. Add the clam liquid and 500ml milk and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream, the clams and thyme.

w.note: Sponge filled with pastry cream under dark ganache
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs and 150g sugar until thick and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 20 minutes. Cook 400ml milk, 3 yolks, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour until thick and cool. Fill the sponge and pour over 150g chocolate melted with 100ml cream.

d.note: Brandy in a warmed snifter, coffee for anyone who'd rather not
d.how: Warm four snifters with hot water and dry them. Pour 45ml brandy into each and swirl. Brew 60g coffee with 1L water for anyone who would rather keep a clear head on the island.

s.note: Buttery salted popcorn in striped paper bags
s.how: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels, then add 120g kernels once they pop, cover and shake until popping slows. Toss with 50g melted butter and fine salt while hot. Fill four striped paper bags.

s.note: Two-tone pink and white coconut ice squares
s.how: Mix 250g desiccated coconut, a 395g tin condensed milk and 250g icing sugar into a stiff mix. Press half into a lined tin. Tint the rest pink, press it on top and chill 3 hours. Cut into squares.

m.note: Fifties diner smashed cheeseburgers with mustard, sauce and pickles
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g beef mince on a smoking griddle, salt and flip at 90 seconds, adding American cheese. Stack two per soft toasted bun with diced onion, pickles, mustard and tomato sauce.

w.note: Strawberry and hot fudge sundae with a cherry on top
w.how: Blitz 250g strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses and spoon over both sauces. Top with whipped cream and a cherry.

d.note: Fresh lemonade turned pink with raspberry
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blitz 125g raspberries and strain. Mix the syrup, raspberry, juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water. Pour over ice in four glasses.

s.note: Corn chips with fresh guacamole and salsa
s.how: Mash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes, finely chopped onion, coriander and a little chilli. Dice 3 tomatoes with onion and lime juice for salsa. Serve both with a 300g bag of corn chips.

s.note: Cinnamon sugar pretzels with a cream cheese icing dip
s.how: Brush 4 soft pretzels with 40g melted butter and roll in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Beat 125g cream cheese with 60g icing sugar for dipping.

m.note: Salmon sushi bowls with avocado, cucumber and edamame
m.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar and sugar. Top bowls with 400g sliced sashimi salmon, sliced avocado, cucumber, 200g edamame and pickled ginger. Dress with soy mixed with a little sesame oil.

w.note: Pastel strawberry and vanilla buttercream cupcakes
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, blend some with mashed strawberry for pink, pipe and add sprinkles.

d.note: Mango, strawberry and banana smoothie, straight from the food court
d.how: Blend 1 mango, 250g strawberries, 1 banana, 500ml orange juice and a cup of ice until smooth. Pour into four tall glasses with straws. As if you'd have anything else.

s.note: Neat crustless ham and Swiss triangles with mustard
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread and spread with Dijon. Fill with 200g sliced ham and 100g Swiss cheese. Cut off the crusts and cut into neat triangles. Serve on a plate with a glass of milk alongside.

s.note: Sharp spiced pickled onions in a jar
s.how: Peel 500g pickling onions and soak in salted water overnight. Rinse and pack into a jar. Boil 500ml malt vinegar with 100g sugar and 1 tsp peppercorns and pour over hot. Seal and leave a week before eating.

m.note: Beef stew with potatoes and carrot, with crusty bread
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 carrots, add 750ml stock and thyme, cover and braise at 160C for 2.5 hours. Add 600g diced potatoes for the last hour. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Tall swirled meringues with raspberry coulis drizzled over
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites and 180g sugar over simmering water until hot, then beat to stiff peaks. Pipe tall swirls and bake at 100C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Blitz 200g raspberries with lemon juice and sugar and drizzle over.

d.note: A tall glass of cold full cream milk
d.how: Chill 1L full cream milk in the coldest part of the fridge. Pour into four tall glasses and serve. A boy's best friend is his mother, and a glass of milk goes well with sandwiches.

s.note: Loaded bar nachos with pico, guacamole and sour cream
s.how: Layer a 300g bag of corn chips with a drained tin of black beans, 200g cheddar and jalapeños and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime. Dice 2 tomatoes with onion and coriander. Spoon on with 150g sour cream.

s.note: Pulled pork sliders with barbecue sauce and slaw
s.how: Rub 1kg pork shoulder with 1 tbsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp brown sugar, cover and roast at 150C for 5 hours. Shred with 150ml barbecue sauce. Shred a quarter cabbage with a little mayo. Pile into 12 slider buns with slaw.

m.note: Garlic chilli butterflied prawns with cos salad and bread
m.how: Butterfly 1kg green prawns in the shell. Brush with 80g butter melted with 3 garlic cloves, chilli, lemon zest and parsley. Grill for 2 minutes a side. Toss cos and sliced cucumber with lemon and oil. Serve with crusty bread for the butter.

w.note: Tangy key lime pie with whipped cream
w.how: Press 200g crushed biscuits mixed with 80g melted butter into a pie tin. Whisk 395g condensed milk with 4 yolks, the zest of 2 limes and 125ml lime juice. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes, chill overnight and top with 300ml whipped cream.

d.note: Lager lined up along the bar from an ice tub
d.how: Fill a tub with a bag of ice and some water and bury eight 355ml bottles of American lager for 30 minutes. Line them up along the bench for the squadron and crack them open together.

s.note: Garlic thyme sirloin cubes with horseradish cream
s.how: Cut 600g sirloin into cubes and season well. Sear in a smoking pan in batches, then baste with 40g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme. Rest 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 tbsp horseradish. Serve on toothpicks.

s.note: Warm yeasted doughnuts tossed in caster sugar
s.how: Mix 350g flour, 7g yeast, 40g butter, 1 egg, 2 tbsp sugar and 180ml warm water and rest an hour. Roll out, cut rounds and prove 30 minutes. Fry at 175C for 90 seconds a side and toss in 100g caster sugar while warm.

m.note: Slow-roasted pork belly glazed sticky with soy and ginger
m.how: Roast 1kg pork belly at 150C for 2 hours. Simmer 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp brown sugar and grated ginger until syrupy. Slice the pork, brush with glaze and grill until sticky. Serve with 300g steamed rice and greens.

w.note: Vanilla custards under a sugar crust torched to a crack
w.how: Warm 600ml cream with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 6 yolks with 80g sugar and pour the cream over. Pour into 4 ramekins and bake in a water bath at 150C for 35 minutes. Chill overnight, sprinkle with sugar and torch until it cracks.

d.note: Strong coffee with as much sugar as you dare
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water so it's strong. Pour into four mugs and stir in sugar, two or three spoons each, more if you dare. Add milk only if you must.

s.note: Peppery parmesan popcorn coated while hot
s.how: Pop 120g kernels in a lidded pot with 2 tbsp oil. Toss straight away in 50g melted butter, 2 tsp cracked black pepper, 40g finely grated parmesan and fine salt so it all sticks while the corn is hot.

s.note: Fairy bread triangles, buttered right to the edges
s.how: Spread 8 slices fresh white bread with soft butter right to the edges. Press face down into a plate of hundreds and thousands. Trim the crusts and cut into triangles. Make it close to serving so it stays soft.

m.note: Red wine braised lamb shanks over mash
m.how: Brown 4 lamb shanks. Soften 1 onion and 2 carrots, add 250ml red wine, a tin of tomatoes and rosemary. Return the shanks, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Serve over 1kg potatoes mashed with butter.

w.note: Kirsch-soaked chocolate sponge with cream and cherries
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick, then fold in 120g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 175C for 25 minutes and split. Brush with syrup and 3 tbsp kirsch. Layer with 400ml whipped cream and a drained jar of morello cherries. Shave dark chocolate on top.

d.note: Dark hot chocolate with a pinch of salt
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate and a pinch of salt until smooth. Pour into four mugs and drink with the lights on.

s.note: Thick-cut chips with homemade French onion dip
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in a little oil for 40 minutes until deep brown, then cool and chop. Fold into 300g sour cream with salt and chopped chives. Serve with a big bag of thick-cut potato chips.

s.note: Peanut butter and milk chocolate dipped pretzel rods
s.how: Warm 100g peanut butter with 1 tbsp honey and dip 20 pretzel rods halfway, then chill 15 minutes. Dip again in 150g melted milk chocolate and set on baking paper.

m.note: Smashed double cheeseburgers wrapped in paper
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g beef mince on a smoking griddle, salt and flip at 90 seconds, adding American cheese. Stack two per toasted bun with sliced onion and pickles. Wrap each in paper and rest a minute.

w.note: Frozen sweet lemon tea on sticks
w.how: Steep 4 black tea bags in 750ml boiling water for 5 minutes. Stir in 100g sugar while hot, add the juice of a lemon and cool. Pour into ice block moulds, add sticks and freeze at least 6 hours.

d.note: Ice-cold lager from a keg or cans, in plastic cups
d.how: Chill 3L of American lager in cans or a mini keg for at least three hours. Pour into plastic cups and hand them around. Just keep livin'.

s.note: Ginger, turmeric, lemon and honey tonic shots
s.how: Blitz a 5cm knob of ginger and a 5cm piece of fresh turmeric with the juice of 2 lemons, 2 tbsp honey and 250ml apple juice. Strain and pour into shot glasses. No tannis root.

s.note: Brandy chicken liver pâté on baguette with fig jam
s.how: Sear 400g trimmed chicken livers in butter until pink inside, then flame with 2 tbsp brandy. Blitz with 150g soft butter and thyme and set in a dish for 4 hours. Spread on toasted baguette with a little fig jam.

m.note: Triple-decker chicken and bacon club sandwich with potato chips
m.how: Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Toast 12 slices of bread. Layer 300g sliced roast chicken, bacon, lettuce and 2 sliced tomatoes with mayo across three slices each. Pin with toothpicks, cut into triangles and serve with potato chips.

w.note: Dark chocolate mousse with cream, set in small cups
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 30g butter. Whisk in 3 yolks, then fold in 3 whites whipped with 40g sugar, then 150ml whipped cream. Spoon into small cups and set 4 hours. Unlike Minnie's, nothing chalky in it.

d.note: Ginger and lemongrass tea with honey and lemon
d.how: Slice a knob of ginger and bruise 2 lemongrass stalks. Steep in 1L boiling water for 5 minutes. Strain and sweeten with honey and lemon juice. Pour into four cups.

s.note: Torn rustic bread with warm orange and fennel olives and good oil
s.how: Warm 300g mixed olives gently in 3 tbsp olive oil with strips of orange peel, 1 tsp fennel seeds and 2 sliced garlic cloves for 5 minutes. Tear a rustic loaf into chunks. Serve with the olives and a bowl of olive oil with salt for dipping.

s.note: Baked figs with goat's cheese, honey and toasted walnuts
s.how: Halve 8 ripe figs and put a small spoon of goat's cheese on each, using 120g in total. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Drizzle with honey, scatter with 60g toasted walnuts and a few thyme leaves and serve warm.

m.note: Garlic and rosemary lamb leg with tomato chickpeas and greens
m.how: Stud a 2kg lamb leg with slivers of 4 garlic cloves, rosemary and 4 anchovies. Roast at 180C to 58C inside, about 90 minutes, and rest 20 minutes. Simmer 2 tins chickpeas with a tin of tomatoes and a handful of greens. Carve and serve.

w.note: Little ricotta cakes baked on bay leaves and soaked in honey
w.how: Mix 250g ricotta, 100g flour and 1 egg into a soft dough. Shape into 8 small rounds, put each on a bay leaf and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Pour over 4 tbsp warmed honey and sprinkle with poppy seeds.

d.note: Red wine warmed with honey, pepper, bay and orange
d.how: Pour a 750ml bottle of red wine into a pot with 3 tbsp honey, half a tsp black peppercorns, 2 bay leaves and strips of orange peel. Warm gently for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into cups.

s.note: Tasmanian cheddar, brie and blue with apple, walnuts and leatherwood honey
s.how: Take 150g vintage cheddar, 150g brie and 150g blue cheese out of the fridge an hour ahead. Toast 80g walnuts at 170C for 8 minutes. Arrange on a board with a sliced apple, crackers and a little dish of leatherwood honey.

s.note: Curried scallop pies with puff pastry lids
s.how: Soften a diced onion in butter, add 1 tsp curry powder and 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Stir in 300g scallops off the heat and cool. Line patty tins with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill, top with 2 sheets puff and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

m.note: Pork chops simmered in apple cider with sage, over mash
m.how: Brown 4 pork chops and set aside. Soften a sliced onion and 2 sliced apples with sage. Pour in 375ml apple cider, return the chops and simmer 20 minutes until the sauce reduces. Serve over 1kg potatoes mashed with butter.

w.note: Double crust Granny Smith apple pie with cream
w.how: Toss 1kg sliced Granny Smiths with 120g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and cover with 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve warm with 300ml cream.

d.note: Australian lager poured with a proper head
d.how: Chill eight 375ml bottles of Australian lager. Pour down the side of a cold glass, then straight up at the end to leave a proper head of bubbles. Toast to splitting the beer atom.

s.note: Mini franks in rolls with beef chilli, mustard and onion
s.how: Brown 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika, add 150ml water and simmer 20 minutes. Simmer 16 cocktail franks for 5 minutes. Tuck into split mini rolls, spoon over chilli, add mustard and diced onion.

s.note: Ridged chips with a jammy onion and chive dip
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 40 minutes until jammy, then cool and chop. Fold into 200g sour cream and 100g cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives. Serve with a big bag of ridged potato chips.

m.note: Double smashed burger with mustard mayo, pickles and onion
m.how: Roll 800g chuck mince into 8 loose balls and smash hard on a smoking griddle. Flip once, add American cheese and stack two per toasted bun. Mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp mustard and add with pickles and onion.

w.note: Soft chocolate cookie ice cream sandwiches rolled in choc chips
w.how: Beat 100g butter and 150g brown sugar with 1 egg, then mix in 150g flour and 30g cocoa. Scoop 8 cookies and bake at 175C for 9 minutes. Cool, sandwich with thick slices of vanilla ice cream, roll the edges in mini choc chips and freeze an hour.

d.note: A big jug of fresh lemonade with lemon slices
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water in a big jug. Add sliced lemon and plenty of ice and pour into four glasses.

s.note: Thin fries in paper cones with garlic salt and parsley
s.how: Cut 1kg russets into thin fries, soak for 30 minutes and dry well. Fry at 140C for 5 minutes, rest, then at 190C until golden. Toss with fine salt, garlic powder and chopped parsley and serve in paper cones.

s.note: Crisp baguette loaded with garlic butter, for protection
s.how: Mash 100g soft butter with 4 crushed garlic cloves, chopped parsley and salt. Split a baguette, spread generously, wrap in foil and bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Open the foil and bake 3 minutes more to crisp.

m.note: Wok-tossed chicken lo mein with fried rice alongside
m.how: Stir-fry 500g sliced chicken thighs in a smoking wok, then add a quarter cabbage, 200g bean sprouts and 400g fresh egg noodles. Toss with 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp soy and sesame oil. Fry 300g cooked jasmine rice with egg and spring onion alongside.

w.note: Crunchy baked caramel popcorn from the boardwalk
w.how: Pop 120g kernels. Boil 150g brown sugar, 80g butter and 3 tbsp golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in half a tsp bicarb. Pour over the popcorn, toss and bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15. Cool and break up.

d.note: Lime lemonade in little bottles marked with a cross
d.how: Squeeze 2 limes into 1.25L cold lemonade and pour into four small glass bottles over ice. Draw a cross on each label. Keep a water pistol filled nearby, just in case.

s.note: Smoked salmon blini and goat's cheese cucumber rounds on silver trays
s.how: Top 16 blinis with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, dill and lemon zest. Cut a cucumber into thick rounds and pipe on 120g goat's cheese whipped with chives. Lay both neatly on silver trays.

s.note: Smoky devilled eggs finished with chives
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon, a dash of vinegar and a pinch of smoked paprika. Pipe back into the whites and finish with chives and more paprika.

m.note: Grilled butterflied lamb with bright salsa verde
m.how: Marinate a 1.5kg butterflied lamb leg overnight with 4 garlic cloves, rosemary, lemon and olive oil. Grill over high heat until 55C inside and rest 15 minutes. Chop parsley, capers, garlic and lemon with oil for salsa verde. Slice and spoon over.

w.note: Vanilla panna cotta set in teacups with berry compote
w.how: Soak 3 gelatine leaves. Warm 600ml cream with 80g sugar and a split vanilla bean, then stir in the gelatine. Pour into 4 teacups and set 4 hours. Simmer 200g mixed berries with a spoon of sugar and spoon on top. Serve with silver spoons.

d.note: Sweet black iced tea with lemon and mint
d.how: Brew 6 black tea bags in 1L just-boiled water for 5 minutes and stir in 80g sugar while hot. Cool completely. Pour over ice in four glasses with lemon slices and fresh mint.

s.note: Smoky brown butter popcorn in striped bags
s.how: Pop 120g kernels. Cook 60g butter until golden and nutty, then stir in 1 tsp smoked paprika, a pinch of chipotle powder and fine salt. Toss through the popcorn and fill striped paper bags.

s.note: Steamed bao with smoky barbecue chicken and pickled onion
s.how: Quick-pickle a sliced red onion in 60ml white vinegar with salt and sugar. Poach and shred 500g chicken thighs and toss with 150ml barbecue sauce. Steam 12 bao buns and fill with chicken, pickled onion and coriander.

m.note: Coal-grilled rump cap with pinto beans and fresh salsa
m.how: Rub a 1.2kg rump cap with salt, pepper and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Grill over coals, fat side first, until 54C inside and rest 10 minutes. Warm 2 tins pinto beans. Dice 3 tomatoes with onion, coriander and lime for salsa. Slice and serve.

w.note: Chocolate cookie saucers filled with marshmallow, edged in silver
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100g butter, beat in 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then 180g flour. Bake 16 small rounds at 175C for 9 minutes. Sandwich pairs with a marshmallow each, warm 1 minute to melt, then roll the edges in silver sprinkles.

d.note: Peach iced tea over plenty of ice
d.how: Brew 6 black tea bags in 1L just-boiled water for 5 minutes, stir in 60g sugar and cool. Add 250ml peach nectar and the juice of a lemon. Pour over plenty of ice in four tall glasses.

s.note: Light country scones packed close, with jam and cream
s.how: Rub 60g cold butter into 350g self-raising flour. Mix in 200ml milk and 50ml cream lightly with a knife. Pat out, cut rounds and pack close on a tray. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with strawberry jam and 250ml whipped cream.

s.note: Cheesy yeast spread scrolls, straight from the oven
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 300g self-raising flour and mix in 200ml milk to a soft dough. Roll into a rectangle, spread thinly with yeast spread and cover with 150g grated tasty cheese. Roll up, slice into 12 and bake at 200C for 15 minutes.

m.note: Roast lamb cutlets with pumpkin, potatoes, peas and mint sauce
m.how: Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin at 200C for 45 minutes. Roast 2 lamb racks at 200C until 56C inside, rest and carve into cutlets. Cook 300g peas. Mix chopped mint with 3 tbsp vinegar, a spoon of sugar and hot water for mint sauce.

w.note: A perfect round pavlova with cream and passionfruit
w.how: Whip 4 whites to soft peaks, add 220g caster sugar gradually until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Shape a perfect round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream and 4 passionfruit.

d.note: Half lager, half lemonade, in a chilled pot glass
d.how: Chill four pot glasses. Fill each halfway with cold Australian lager, then top with cold lemonade. Add a lemon wedge if you're feeling fancy, then toast the moon.

s.note: Cast iron cornbread with honey butter
s.how: Heat a buttered cast iron pan in a 220C oven. Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter briefly. Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes. Serve with 60g butter beaten with 2 tbsp honey.

s.note: Red apple slices with aged cheddar, walnuts and honey
s.how: Slice 2 red apples thin and toss in lemon juice. Fan out on a board with 200g sharp aged cheddar cut into slices. Toast 80g walnuts at 170C for 8 minutes and scatter over, then drizzle with honey.

m.note: Slow-braised goat or lamb shoulder with thyme and bay
m.how: Brown 1.5kg goat or lamb shoulder in big pieces. Soften 2 onions, 3 carrots and 4 garlic cloves, add 750ml stock, thyme and 2 bay leaves. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until it falls apart. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Spiced baked apples stuffed with dates and brown sugar
w.how: Core 4 apples and fill each with a mix of 40g butter, 60g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 60g chopped dates. Add a splash of water to the dish and bake at 180C for 40 minutes, basting twice. Serve with pouring cream.

d.note: Hot cloudy apple juice with cinnamon, cloves and star anise
d.how: Simmer 1.5L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 star anise and strips of orange peel for 15 minutes. Strain and ladle into four mugs. Drink it by the fire with the door shut.

s.note: Cold watermelon wedges with feta, mint and lime
s.how: Cut 1kg watermelon into thick wedges. Top with 150g crumbled feta, torn mint and a squeeze of lime, then a pinch of flaky salt. Serve ice cold. Carry it in with both arms.

s.note: Pretzels and chips with a slow-caramelised onion dip
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly for 40 minutes until deep brown, cool and chop. Fold into 300g sour cream with salt and chives. Serve with bowls of 200g pretzels and a bag of potato chips.

m.note: Slow-braised brisket on onions with paprika and its juices
m.how: Brown a 1.5kg brisket. Lay on 3 sliced onions in a roasting dish with 500ml stock, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tsp sweet paprika. Cover and braise at 150C for 4 hours. Slice across the grain and spoon over the juices.

w.note: Bright watermelon and lime sorbet scraped into cups
w.how: Blitz 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and 100g sugar dissolved in 100ml hot water. Strain, pour into a tray and freeze for 4 hours, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes. Scoop into cups.

d.note: Pineapple and orange punch with lemonade
d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a punch bowl with ice. Top with 750ml lemonade and float a sliced orange on top. Ladle into glasses.

s.note: Soft lettuce cups of rice, chicken and herbs, no crunch
s.how: Cook 200g jasmine rice. Poach a chicken breast gently and shred. Spoon rice and chicken into butter lettuce leaves with thin cucumber, mint and a dressing of lime juice and a little fish sauce. Nothing crunchy anywhere.

s.note: Warm soft pretzels with a smooth cheese dip
s.how: Brush 4 soft pretzels with butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Heat 375ml evaporated milk and stir in 200g grated cheddar until smooth. Serve warm, and dip quietly.

m.note: Whole trout baked in foil with lemon, dill and butter
m.how: Stuff 2 whole trout with lemon slices, dill and sliced garlic. Dot with 40g butter and wrap each in foil. Bake at 200C for 18 minutes and open at the table. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss with butter.

w.note: Silky vanilla custard with soft poached pears
w.how: Poach 2 peeled, halved pears in sugar syrup for 15 minutes. Whisk 4 yolks, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour. Pour over 400ml hot milk and 100ml cream, then stir over low heat until thick. Add vanilla, chill in cups and top with the pears.

d.note: Sparkling water poured gently over cucumber and mint
d.how: Put a few cucumber ribbons and mint leaves in each of four glasses with no ice, so nothing clinks. Pour chilled sparkling water in slowly down the side. Sip without a sound.

s.note: Lemony crab piled on garlic-rubbed sourdough
s.how: Fold 250g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, chopped chives and a pinch of cayenne. Toast 8 small slices of sourdough and rub with a cut garlic clove. Pile the crab on top and serve straight away.

s.note: Crisp filo nests with goat's cheese, peas and mint, in pairs
s.how: Cut 4 sheets filo into squares, brush with 40g melted butter and press into a mini muffin tin in layers. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp. Fill with 120g whipped goat's cheese, a few blanched peas and a mint leaf. Serve two to a plate.

m.note: Seafood stew of mussels, clams, prawns and snapper with sourdough
m.how: Soften an onion, a fennel bulb and 3 garlic cloves in oil. Add a tin of tomatoes, 250ml white wine and 500ml fish stock and simmer 20 minutes. Add 500g mussels and 500g clams, then 300g prawns and 300g snapper. Serve with sourdough.

w.note: Little meringue nests with lemon curd and speckled eggs
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites and 180g sugar over simmering water until hot, then beat to stiff peaks. Pipe 8 small nests and bake at 100C for 90 minutes. Cool, fill with lemon curd and top each with three speckled chocolate eggs.

d.note: Hot coffee with whiskey and cream floated on top
d.how: Brew 60g coffee with 1L water. For each glass, stir 2 tsp brown sugar into 150ml hot coffee with 30ml Irish whiskey. Pour 200ml lightly whipped cream over the back of a spoon so it floats.

s.note: A dozen devilled eggs with paprika and chives
s.how: Boil 12 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and halve. Whip the yolks with 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and 20g soft butter until smooth. Pipe back into the whites and finish with smoked paprika and chives.

s.note: Toasted baguette with brie, pear and honey
s.how: Slice a baguette, brush with olive oil and toast at 200C for 8 minutes. Top each slice with 200g sliced brie and a thin slice of pear from 2 pears. Drizzle with honey and serve warm.

m.note: Roast chicken with potatoes and rich gravy, eaten with your hands
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter and salt. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes, with 1kg potatoes in the tray. Rest, then make gravy with the pan juices, thyme and 300ml stock. Tear it apart at the table.

w.note: Rosewater panna cotta with crushed raspberries and a rose petal
w.how: Soak 3 gelatine leaves. Warm 600ml cream with 80g sugar, stir in the gelatine and a few drops of rosewater. Pour into 4 glasses and set 4 hours. Top with 150g raspberries crushed with sugar and a single sugared rose petal.

d.note: Scraped apple slush under marshmallow cream, or tea for grown-ups
d.how: Freeze 1L cloudy apple juice with the juice of a lemon in a tray, scraping every 30 minutes for 3 hours. Fold 3 tbsp marshmallow creme into 150ml whipped cream and spoon on top. Brew a pot of English breakfast tea for the grown-ups.

s.note: Raw garlic butter baguette, crisp and very garlicky
s.how: Mash 100g soft butter with 5 crushed raw garlic cloves, chopped parsley and salt. Split a baguette, spread thickly, wrap in foil and bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Open the foil for the last 3 minutes to crisp.

s.note: Crisp apple slices with whipped honey peanut butter
s.how: Slice 3 red apples and toss in lemon juice. Whip 150g peanut butter with 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt until light. Fan the apples around the dip. Don't invite anyone in without checking first.

m.note: Chicken braised with forty cloves of garlic and white wine
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs skin side down. Add 40 unpeeled garlic cloves, thyme and 200ml white wine. Cover and bake at 180C for an hour. Squeeze the soft garlic onto slices of crusty bread and eat with the chicken.

w.note: Double crust apple pie with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 1kg sliced Granny Smiths with 120g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp flour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill, cover with 2 more and egg wash. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Lime lemonade in small glass bottles, just in case
d.how: Squeeze 2 limes into 1.25L cold lemonade. Pour over ice into four small glass bottles. Keep one by the front door for the neighbour, just in case.

s.note: Mini pepperoni pizzas served in a pizza box
s.how: Roll out 500g pizza dough and cut into 16 rounds. Spread with pizza sauce and top with grated mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni. Bake at 230C for 8 minutes and serve in a pizza box.

s.note: Salted pretzels with a warm cheese sauce
s.how: Brush 4 soft pretzels with butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Heat 375ml evaporated milk and stir in 200g grated cheddar until smooth. Serve warm in paper cups for dipping.

m.note: Classic sesame bun cheeseburger with the works and fries
m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties and grill to medium, melting cheddar on top. Build on toasted sesame buns with iceberg, tomato, onion and pickles. Fry 1kg potatoes cut into fries, twice, and salt well.

w.note: Big soft brown butter choc chip cookies
w.how: Brown 150g butter and cool. Beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour, half a tsp bicarb and 200g choc chips. Rest overnight. Scoop 10 big balls and bake at 180C for 11 minutes.

d.note: Cola over lots of ice in big paper cups
d.how: Fill four big paper cups with ice. Pour a 375ml can of cola into each and add a straw. Drink it slowly while doing absolutely nothing useful.

s.note: Black and white peppered popcorn that looks like static
s.how: Pop 120g kernels and toss with 50g melted butter, fine salt, 1 tsp cracked black pepper and 1 tbsp black sesame seeds until it looks like TV static. Serve in a bowl in front of the screen.

s.note: A crooked tower of cheese and crackers skewered through
s.how: Slice 150g cheddar, 150g gouda and 150g Swiss thickly. Stack in crooked towers with a cracker between each layer and push a long skewer through the middle to hold them. Make four towers.

m.note: Cheesy tuna pasta bake with peas and crumbs
m.how: Cook 400g pasta shells. Melt 40g butter, stir in 3 tbsp flour and whisk in 600ml milk until thick, then add 150g cheddar. Mix with 2 drained 185g tins tuna, 200g peas and the pasta. Top with breadcrumbs and 50g cheese and bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

w.note: Tall ghostly white meringue drops, crisp outside and soft inside
