w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites with a pinch of cream of tartar to soft peaks, then add 180g caster sugar a spoon at a time until stiff and glossy. Pipe tall drops and bake at 100C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven.

d.note: Fresh lemonade in a big jug with ice
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water in a jug. Add sliced lemon and plenty of ice. Stay away from the light.

s.note: Coconut prawns with sweet chilli and lime
s.how: Dip 500g peeled green prawns in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then a mix of 60g panko and 60g shredded coconut. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes. Serve with sweet chilli sauce mixed with lime juice.

s.note: Little cups of tuna poke on rice with cucumber
s.how: Cook 200g sushi rice and cool. Dice 300g sashimi tuna and toss with 2 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, spring onion and a little chilli. Spoon rice into small cups, top with tuna and cucumber.

m.note: Snapper poached in coconut milk with lime leaf and ginger
m.how: Simmer 400ml coconut milk with 3 lime leaves, a sliced knob of ginger and a sliced chilli for 5 minutes. Add 600g snapper fillets and poach gently for 8 minutes. Finish with lime juice and coriander. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.note: Set coconut pudding squares with mango and toasted coconut
w.how: Whisk 800ml coconut milk, 100g sugar and 60g cornflour together in a pot. Stir over medium heat until very thick, pour into a tray and chill 3 hours. Cut into squares and top with toasted shredded coconut and diced mango.

d.note: Chilled coconut water with lime and mint
d.how: Pour 1L chilled coconut water over ice in four glasses. Add a squeeze of lime and a few torn mint leaves to each. Serve in a halved coconut if you can crack one open.

s.note: Little sausage rolls with carrot, with tomato sauce
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with 1 grated carrot and 1 grated onion. Lay along 2 sheets puff pastry, roll up, egg wash and cut into 20 small rolls. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.

s.note: Minty peas and edamame in little toy buckets
s.how: Blanch 200g peas and 200g edamame for 2 minutes and drain. Toss with chopped mint, lemon zest and juice, 2 tbsp olive oil and flaky salt. Spoon into little toy buckets or cups.

m.note: Golden cheese toasties with roast tomato soup
m.how: Roast 1kg tomatoes, an onion and 3 garlic cloves at 200C for 30 minutes, blend with 250ml stock and 100ml cream. Fill 8 slices sourdough with 150g cheddar and 100g mozzarella, butter the outsides and grill slowly until golden.

w.note: Chocolate birthday cake with a fondant cowboy hat
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Cover in 200g butter beaten with 350g icing sugar and 40g cocoa. Top with a fondant cowboy hat and candles.

d.note: Bright blue raspberry lemonade slushie, blitzed thick with ice
d.how: Blitz 150ml blue raspberry cordial with 500ml lemonade and 4 cups of ice until slushy. Pour into four cups with spoon straws and drink it to infinity and beyond.

s.note: Cucumber, egg and smoked salmon finger sandwiches on a stand
s.how: Boil 3 eggs and mash with mayo and cress. Make sandwiches of cucumber with 100g cream cheese, the egg, and 100g smoked salmon with dill, using 12 slices white bread. Cut off the crusts and cut into fingers. Lay on a tiered stand.

s.note: Neat triangles of cheddar, Swiss and blue with grapes
s.how: Cut 150g vintage cheddar, 150g Swiss and 100g blue cheese into neat triangles. Arrange on a board with crackers, a bunch of grapes and slices of quince paste. Leave a few crumbs for any mice.

m.note: Bright green watercress and potato soup with cream
m.how: Sweat 2 sliced leeks and 2 diced potatoes in 40g butter for 10 minutes. Add 1L chicken stock and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in 2 bunches watercress for 1 minute, then blitz until bright green. Finish with 100ml cream.

w.note: Rich dark chocolate cake under thick ganache, in thin slices
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter. Whisk 4 eggs with 200g sugar and fold in the chocolate, 100g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Cover with 150g chocolate melted with 150ml cream. Serve thin slices.

d.note: A warmed pot of English breakfast tea
d.how: Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 4 tea bags and 1L freshly boiled water and brew 4 minutes. Pour into cups with milk and sugar on the side, very proper.

s.note: Cheese, salami and tomato on toothpicks in rows of exactly ten
s.how: Cut 200g cheddar into 20 even cubes. Thread each onto a toothpick with a fold of salami from 100g and a cherry tomato from a 250g punnet. Lay them out in two neat rows of exactly ten.

s.note: Iced prawns on crushed ice with cocktail sauce
s.how: Poach 500g green prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel. Mix 125ml tomato sauce with 1 tbsp horseradish and lemon juice. Pile on crushed ice with the sauce and lemon wedges, buffet style.

m.note: Buttermilk pancakes, with the syrup on the table first
m.how: Put the maple syrup on the table before anything else. Whisk 300g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 tbsp sugar, 500ml buttermilk and 2 eggs and rest 15 minutes. Cook in butter until bubbles set and stack high.

w.note: Real strawberry jelly with whipped cream, same every time
w.how: Blitz 500g strawberries with 100g sugar and strain. Soak 5 gelatine leaves, dissolve in 200ml hot water and stir into the purée. Pour into four glasses and set 4 hours. Top with a spoon of whipped cream.

d.note: Cold apple juice, no ice, at the same time every day
d.how: Chill 1L cloudy apple juice in the fridge for at least three hours. Pour into four glasses with no ice at all. Serve at exactly the same time as last time, every time, definitely.

s.note: Stovetop popcorn shaken in a heavy pot, buttered and salted
s.how: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels in a heavy covered pot. When they pop, add 120g kernels and shake constantly until the popping slows. Tip out and toss with 50g melted butter and fine salt.

s.note: Corn chips with a juicy fresh tomato salsa
s.how: Dice 4 tomatoes, half a red onion and a jalapeño. Mix with chopped coriander, the juice of a lime and salt, and leave 10 minutes to get juicy. Serve with a 300g bag of corn chips.

m.note: Cheeseburgers with the works and fries alongside
m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties and grill to medium, melting cheddar on top under a lid. Build on toasted buns with iceberg, tomato, onion and burger sauce. Fry 1kg potatoes cut into fries, twice.

w.note: Long white iced cookies with a mask face piped on
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Cut into long ovals and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Ice white with 300g icing sugar mixed with egg white, then pipe the face in black icing.

d.note: Lager buried in an esky of ice
d.how: Fill an esky with a bag of ice and some water and bury eight 355ml bottles of American lager for an hour. Hand them out, and don't answer the phone.

s.note: Golden filo triangles of spinach, feta and dill, straight from the oven
s.how: Wilt 400g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 200g feta, chopped dill, 3 spring onions and 1 egg. Cut 6 sheets filo into strips, brush with 60g melted butter, add a spoon of filling and fold into triangles. Bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

s.note: Griddled haloumi with honey and chilli, more as fast as it goes
s.how: Slice 2 blocks of haloumi, about 500g, into thick pieces. Griddle in a hot dry pan for 2 minutes a side until golden. Drizzle with honey, sprinkle with chilli flakes and thyme, and squeeze over lemon. Cook more as fast as it disappears.

m.note: Lemon oregano lamb skewers with pita and tzatziki
m.how: Marinate 1kg diced lamb leg in lemon juice, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp oregano and oil for 2 hours. Thread onto skewers and grill hot. Mix 300g Greek yoghurt with grated cucumber and garlic. Serve in 4 warm pita with tomato and red onion.

w.note: Honey-soaked Greek doughnut puffs with cinnamon and walnuts
w.how: Mix 250g flour, 7g yeast, a pinch of salt and 300ml warm water to a thick batter and rest an hour. Drop spoonfuls into 175C oil and fry until puffed and golden. Toss in 150g warm honey with cinnamon and scatter over 60g chopped walnuts.

d.note: Peach nectar with sparkling water, lemon and mint
d.how: Fill four glasses with ice. Pour 150ml peach nectar into each, top with sparkling water and a squeeze of lemon. Add a sprig of mint and serve to the gods.

s.note: Salmon and avocado sushi rolls with soy and pickled ginger
s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar and sugar. Spread over 4 nori sheets, lay 200g sliced salmon, avocado and cucumber along each and roll tight. Slice with a wet knife and serve with soy and pickled ginger.

s.note: Oat cookies loaded with bright candy buttons and choc chips
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg. Mix in 120g flour, 100g oats and half a tsp bicarb, then 100g chocolate buttons and 80g choc chips. Scoop 16 cookies and bake at 180C for 11 minutes.

m.note: Charred teriyaki chicken thighs with rice and greens
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 60ml soy, 60ml mirin, 2 tbsp sake and 2 tbsp sugar for an hour. Grill until charred, then reduce the marinade to a glaze and brush over. Serve with 300g jasmine rice and steamed bok choy.

w.note: Fuzzy blue buttercream cake with purple spots
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour, 100ml milk and blue colouring. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Beat 250g butter with 450g icing sugar, tint blue and pipe in fuzzy strands with a grass tip. Add purple spots.

d.note: Pineapple and lemon slushie in clear glasses
d.how: Blend 600ml pineapple juice with the juice of 2 lemons and 4 cups of ice until thick and slushy. Pour into four clear glasses and serve straight away with spoon straws.

s.note: Thick buttered toast fingers with honey, jam and yeast spread
s.how: Toast 8 thick slices of white bread until golden and butter while hot. Cut into fingers and pile on a plate with little pots of honey, strawberry jam and yeast spread. Throwing it at the screen is optional.

s.note: White chocolate pretzel rods with red and gold sprinkles
s.how: Melt 200g white chocolate. Dip 20 pretzel rods two-thirds of the way, tap to drain and roll in red and gold sprinkles. Lay on baking paper and leave to set for 20 minutes.

m.note: Glazed beef and pork meatloaf for the dinner party
m.how: Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk, then mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and Worcestershire. Shape in a loaf tin, glaze with 4 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp brown sugar and bake at 180C for an hour.

w.note: Jam and cream sponge under gold-brushed buttercream
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Fill with strawberry jam and 200ml whipped cream. Cover in 200g butter beaten with 350g icing sugar, brush with edible gold and add candles.

d.note: Cranberry, vodka and lime shaken and served in a coupe
d.how: For each drink, shake 60ml cranberry juice, 30ml vodka and 10ml lime juice hard with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe. Makes four, so shake them two at a time.

s.note: Baked nachos with beans, cheddar, jalapeño and salsa
s.how: Spread a 300g bag of corn chips on a tray with a drained tin of black beans, 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes until melted. Top with 200g sour cream and a jar of salsa.

s.note: Sausage rolls in pastry a bit too small, so they split
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with a grated onion and chopped thyme. Wrap in 2 sheets puff pastry, pulled a little tight so it splits in the oven. Egg wash, cut into 12 and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

m.note: Hot sauce wings, double-fried chips and blue cheese dip
m.how: Dry 1.2kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 60g butter. Fry 1kg potato chips twice. Mix 80g blue cheese into 150g sour cream to dip, with celery sticks.

w.note: Lattice cherry pie with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 800g pitted cherries with 150g sugar and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more sheets. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Ice-cold lager in the bottle, motel style
d.how: Chill eight 355ml bottles of American lager for at least three hours, or in a motel sink full of ice for 30 minutes. Drink straight from the bottle on the end of the bed.

s.note: Peanuts, raisins, choc chips and pretzels in paper cups
s.how: Toss 200g peanuts, 150g raisins, 100g choc chips and 100g pretzels in a big bowl. Scoop into paper cups, one for every camper. Sing nothing cheerful.

s.note: Shortbread rounds with a thin chocolate smile, as rare as hers
s.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g icing sugar and mix in 350g flour. Roll out, cut rounds and bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Cool, then pipe a thin line of 50g melted dark chocolate across each as a small smile.

m.note: Garlic lemon butter lobster tails with new potatoes and salad
m.how: Split 4 lobster tails and brush with 80g butter melted with 2 garlic cloves and lemon zest. Grill flesh side up for 6 to 8 minutes. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss with butter. Serve with dressed salad leaves and lemon wedges.

w.note: Spiced pumpkin pie in a crisp pastry case
w.how: Roast 800g pumpkin, purée and whisk with 3 eggs, 150g brown sugar, 200ml cream and 2 tsp mixed spice. Pour into a blind-baked case of 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Cool before slicing.

d.note: Fresh camp lemonade in a big jug with ice
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water in a big jug. Add lemon slices and plenty of ice.

s.note: Hazelnut chocolate truffles dressed up as little acorns
s.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate, stir smooth and chill 3 hours. Roll into small ovals and coat the bottom half in 100g chopped toasted hazelnuts. Push a short piece of pretzel rod in the top as the stalk.

s.note: Cold tzatziki with crisp pita chips
s.how: Grate a cucumber and squeeze out the water. Mix with 300g Greek yoghurt, a crushed garlic clove, chopped dill and lemon juice. Cut 4 pita into wedges, brush with oil and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp.

m.note: Giant sticky beef short ribs with coleslaw
m.how: Rub 2kg beef short ribs with salt, pepper and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 4 hours. Unwrap, brush with 150ml barbecue sauce and glaze under a hot grill. Shred a quarter cabbage with mayo for slaw.

w.note: Cupcakes covered in marshmallow frosting and coconut snow
w.how: Bake 12 vanilla cupcakes from 125g butter, 150g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour at 180C for 18 minutes. Melt 200g marshmallows with 2 tbsp water and spread over the tops. Roll in 100g desiccated coconut so they look like snowballs.

d.note: Thick frozen berry and lemonade slushie
d.how: Blend 300g frozen mixed berries with 500ml lemonade, the juice of a lemon and a cup of ice until thick and slushy. Pour into four glasses and serve with spoons.

s.note: Golden turmeric pastry patties with spiced beef
s.how: Fry 400g beef mince with an onion, thyme, half a chopped scotch bonnet, 1 tsp allspice and 1 tsp curry powder, then cool. Cut 3 sheets shortcrust into rounds, brush with turmeric water, fill, fold and crimp. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

s.note: Crisp green plantain chips with lime chilli dip
s.how: Peel 3 green plantains and slice thin. Fry at 175C until crisp and salt. Mix the juice of 2 limes with a finely chopped red chilli, a pinch of sugar and salt for dipping.

m.note: Smoky jerk chicken marylands with rice and peas
m.how: Blitz 2 scotch bonnets, 2 tsp allspice, thyme, 4 spring onions, 3 garlic cloves and lime juice into a paste. Marinate 4 chicken marylands overnight. Grill slowly over coals until charred and cooked through. Cook 300g rice with a tin of kidney beans and coconut milk.

w.note: Rum-soaked brown sugar butter cake with whipped cream
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 150g brown sugar and 1 tbsp molasses, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in a ring tin at 170C for 45 minutes. Simmer 60g butter, 80g brown sugar and 80ml dark rum and pour over the hot cake. Serve with 300ml whipped cream.

d.note: Lime, rum, pineapple and orange punch with nutmeg
d.how: Mix the juice of 3 limes, 60ml sugar syrup, 180ml Jamaican rum, 300ml pineapple juice and 300ml orange juice. Pour over ice in four glasses and grate nutmeg on top.

s.note: Goat's cheese rolled in garden herbs and lavender with honey
s.how: Roll a 250g log of goat's cheese in finely chopped rosemary, thyme, a pinch of dried lavender and lemon zest. Drizzle with honey and serve with crackers. Keep a sprig of rosemary on the board for luck.

s.note: Buttery shortbread with a whisper of lavender
s.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g caster sugar, then mix in 350g flour and 1 tsp dried lavender rubbed between your fingers. Press into a tray, prick and bake at 160C for 25 minutes. Dust with sugar and cut while warm.

m.note: Lemon, garlic and herb roast chicken with roast veg
m.how: Stuff a 1.8kg chicken with a halved lemon, 4 garlic cloves and rosemary. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes with 800g potatoes and 3 carrots in the tray. Rest, then make a quick gravy from the juices with lemon.

w.note: Fudgy chocolate cake you're allowed to eat for breakfast
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 3 eggs, 200g sugar and 200ml buttermilk, then fold in 200g flour and 1 tsp bicarb. Bake at 170C for 35 minutes. Frost with 250g icing sugar beaten with 40g cocoa and 80g butter.

d.note: Salt-rimmed tequila margaritas shaken hard, made after midnight
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml lime juice hard with ice. Strain into a glass rimmed with flaky salt. Makes four. Best after midnight in the kitchen.

s.note: Puffy beer-battered cheese curds with a ranch dip
s.how: Whisk 120g flour with 200ml cold lager. Dip 300g cheese curds and fry at 185C for 60 seconds until puffed. Mix 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, chopped dill and chives for ranch. Serve hot.

s.note: Pickles, olives and crisp vegetables on ice with dill dip
s.how: Arrange dill pickle spears, green olives, radishes, celery and carrot sticks on a tray of ice. Mix 200g sour cream with chopped dill and salt for a dip. Serve it like a church buffet, you betcha.

m.note: Beer-battered fish with chips, slaw and tartare
m.how: Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 600g flathead fillets and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Fry 1kg potato chips twice. Shred a quarter cabbage and toss with a little mayo and vinegar. Serve with tartare.

w.note: Lattice cherry pie with ice cream, buffet style
w.how: Toss 800g pitted cherries with 150g sugar and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Hot coffee with milk from a thermos on a cold morning
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water. Stir in 200ml warm milk and pour into a thermos warmed with hot water first. Pour into the lid cup and sip slowly in the cruiser.

s.note: Crackers, pickles, olives, peaches and cheddar from the stores
s.how: Lay out crackers, a big jar of dill pickles, a bowl of olives and a drained tin of peaches on a board like the hotel storeroom. Add a 250g wedge of cheddar for good measure.

s.note: Classic devilled eggs with paprika and chives
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo and 1 tsp Dijon. Pipe back into the whites and finish with smoked paprika and chives. Don't go in there.

m.note: Red wine braised beef with carrots, celery and potatoes
m.how: Brown a 1.5kg chuck roast hard. Soften 2 onions, 3 carrots and 2 celery sticks, add 250ml red wine and 500ml stock, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Add 800g potatoes for the last hour.

w.note: Rich homemade dark chocolate ice cream
w.how: Warm 400ml cream and 300ml milk with 150g dark chocolate and 2 tbsp cocoa. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook, stirring, to 82C. Chill overnight and churn, or freeze and stir every 30 minutes.

d.note: Bourbon over one big block of ice
d.how: Put a large block of ice in each of four heavy tumblers. Pour 60ml bourbon over each. Sip slowly at the bar, and don't trust the bartender.

s.note: Steamed pork and cabbage dumplings, chopsticks only
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups finely shredded wombok, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 chopped spring onions. Fold into 30 dumpling wrappers and steam for 8 minutes. Dip in soy, black vinegar and chilli oil.

s.note: Grilled honey peaches with whipped ricotta and almonds
s.how: Halve 4 ripe peaches and grill cut side down until caramelised. Whip 200g ricotta with a spoon of honey and a pinch of cinnamon. Serve the peaches with the ricotta, more honey and 40g crushed almonds.

m.note: Long-simmered chicken noodle soup with bok choy
m.how: Simmer 1kg chicken frames with ginger, garlic and spring onion in 3L water for 3 hours, then strain. Season with soy and white pepper. Pour over 400g fresh noodles with bok choy and shredded chicken. The secret is there isn't one.

w.note: Golden almond meal cookies with an almond on top
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 120g sugar, then mix in 120g almond meal and 120g flour. Roll into 16 balls, press a whole almond on each and brush with beaten egg. Bake at 170C for 14 minutes until golden.

d.note: Jasmine green tea in small cups
d.how: Heat 1L water to just off the boil, around 85C. Steep 4 tsp jasmine tea for 3 minutes, then strain into small cups. Refill the pot with more water for a second round.

s.note: Toasted marshmallow and chocolate squashed between biscuits
s.how: Toast 16 big marshmallows over a flame until blistered and molten. Squash each between 2 digestive biscuits with a square of milk chocolate, 32 biscuits and 100g chocolate in total, so it melts. Eat them by the handful.

s.note: Hot salted peanuts in paper bags, ballpark style
s.how: Spread 400g peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 20 minutes. Toss with fine salt while hot. Divide into four paper bags and leave a bowl for the shells.

m.note: Charred franks with mustard, relish and buttery onions
m.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in 30g butter for 20 minutes. Score 8 franks and grill over coals until blistered. Toast 8 buns and fill with franks, onions, mustard and sweet relish.

w.n: Carnival fairy floss and toffee apples
w.note: Red toffee apples with fairy floss on the side
w.how: Push sticks into 4 apples. Boil 400g sugar, 125ml water and 2 tbsp golden syrup to 150C, add red colouring and dip and twirl the apples. Set on oiled paper and serve with a bag of fairy floss.

d.note: Big jug of fresh lemonade with lemon slices
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water. Add lemon slices and ice, stir well and pour. For-ev-er.

s.note: Chicken salt chips in butcher's paper with gravy
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry at 140C, then 190C. Toss in chicken salt. Whisk 3 tbsp gravy powder into 375ml boiling water. Serve the chips in butcher's paper with gravy for dipping.

s.note: Spicy pickled onions with tasty cheese and crackers
s.how: Peel 500g pickling onions and soak in salted water overnight. Pack into a jar, then pour over 500ml malt vinegar boiled with 100g sugar, a chilli and 1 tsp peppercorns. Leave a week. Serve with 200g tasty cheese and crackers.

m.note: Proper beef pie with a puff lid and sauce on top
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, add 500ml stock and 2 tbsp Worcestershire and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken and cool. Line 4 pie tins with shortcrust, fill, top with puff and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Sauce on top.

w.note: Ice cream cones with a chocolate shell that sets in seconds
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 2 tbsp coconut oil and cool slightly. Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 waffle cones. Drizzle over the chocolate so it sets hard in seconds. Eat it before it drips.

d.note: Aussie iced coffee with ice cream and cream
d.how: Brew 60g coffee with 500ml water and chill. Pour over ice in four tall glasses with 600ml cold milk. Add a scoop of vanilla ice cream and a swirl of 150ml whipped cream to each.

s.note: Small creamy meatballs with lingonberry jam
s.how: Soak 50g breadcrumbs in milk, then mix with 250g beef mince, 250g pork mince, a grated onion, half a tsp allspice and 1 egg. Roll small and brown in butter. Simmer in 200ml stock and 150ml cream for 10 minutes. Serve with lingonberry jam.

s.note: Rye crispbread with cold butter, shaved cheese and cucumber
s.how: Spread 12 rye crispbreads with cold salted butter. Top with shaved aged hard cheese, about 150g, and cucumber sliced paper thin. Finish with white pepper and dill. Build them just before serving so they stay crisp.

m.note: Swedish prawn toast with dill, lemon and horseradish
m.how: Chop 500g cooked prawns and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, 3 tbsp crème fraîche, chopped dill, lemon juice and 1 tsp horseradish. Fry 4 slices white bread in 40g butter until golden. Pile the prawns on top and add a little roe if you have it.

w.note: Cardamom cinnamon knots with pearl sugar
w.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp cardamom, 75g sugar, 300ml warm milk and 75g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 100g butter, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cinnamon. Cut strips, knot and prove 30 minutes. Brush with egg, add pearl sugar and bake at 220C for 10 minutes.

d.note: Hot blackcurrant cordial with a squeeze of lemon
d.how: Pour 50ml blackcurrant cordial into each of four mugs. Top with hot water from the kettle and add a squeeze of lemon. Wrap your hands around it on a snowy night.

s.note: Kabana, tasty cheese and pickled onions on toothpicks
s.how: Slice 250g kabana on the diagonal and cut 250g tasty cheese into cubes. Thread onto toothpicks with pickled onions. Lay out on a plastic platter with round butter crackers. It's the vibe.

s.note: Cooked king prawns on ice with Marie Rose sauce
s.how: Peel 750g cooked king prawns, leaving the tails on. Pile on crushed ice. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, a dash of Worcestershire and lemon juice. Serve with lemon wedges, and put the platter in the pool room after.

m.note: Beef rissoles in onion gravy with mash and peas
m.how: Mix 800g beef mince with a grated onion and carrot, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs and Worcestershire. Shape into 8 rissoles and fry until browned. Make gravy with a sliced onion, flour and 400ml stock, then simmer the rissoles in it. Serve with mash and 300g peas.

w.note: Feather-light sponge with jam and cream
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g caster sugar for 10 minutes until pale and thick. Sift over 60g cornflour and 60g flour with 1 tsp baking powder and fold gently. Bake in two tins at 180C for 20 minutes. Fill with jam and 300ml whipped cream and dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Ice-cold stubbies straight from the esky
d.how: Fill an esky with a bag of ice and a little water. Bury twelve 375ml stubbies of Australian lager for an hour. Hand them out and tell him he's dreamin'.

s.note: Frozen yoghurt banana coins in peanuts and yellow sprinkles
s.how: Slice 3 bananas into thick coins. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with a spoon of honey. Dip each coin, roll half in crushed peanuts and half in yellow sprinkles, and freeze on a tray for 2 hours.

s.note: Golden corn dogs on sticks with mustard and sauce
s.how: Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.

m.note: Spaghetti and meatballs in garlic basil tomato sauce
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 50g soaked breadcrumbs, 40g parmesan and parsley. Roll into balls and brown. Simmer 40 minutes in 2 tins tomatoes with garlic and basil. Toss with 500g spaghetti and more parmesan.

w.note: Fluffy white unicorn cake with pastel mane and gold horn
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Cover in 250g butter beaten with 450g icing sugar, pipe a pastel mane down one side and add a gold fondant horn.

d.note: Warm honey cinnamon milk for bedtime
d.how: Warm 1L milk gently with 2 tbsp honey, a cinnamon stick and a little vanilla until steaming, never boiling. Remove the cinnamon and pour into four mugs at bedtime.

s.note: Chilled ripe strawberries with sugar and cold bubbles
s.how: Wash and properly dry 500g of the ripest strawberries and chill. Pile them into a glass bowl with a tiny dish of caster sugar for dipping. Open a very cold bottle of sparkling wine alongside.

s.note: Garlic butter mushrooms baked sizzling, with bread for the butter
s.how: Put 20 button mushroom caps or escargot in a baking dish. Mash 100g butter with 3 garlic cloves, parsley, a chopped shallot and a splash of brandy and cover each one. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes until sizzling. Serve with baguette.

m.note: Eye fillet with red wine jus, potato gratin and green beans
m.how: Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream and garlic and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Sear an 800g eye fillet and roast at 200C to 54C, then rest. Reduce shallots with 250ml red wine and 300ml stock for jus. Steam 300g green beans.

w.note: Dark chocolate strawberries drizzled with white chocolate
w.how: Wash and completely dry 500g strawberries. Dip each in 200g melted dark chocolate and set on baking paper. Drizzle thin lines of 50g melted white chocolate across them and chill until set.

d.note: Champagne chilled in an ice bucket and poured into flutes
d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of champagne in an ice bucket with ice and water for 30 minutes. Open gently and pour into four flutes. Big mistake not to. Huge.

s.note: Sesame-topped sausage rolls with tomato sauce
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with a grated onion, a grated carrot and herbs. Roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, egg wash and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Cut into 16 and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.

s.note: Macadamias, dried mango, coconut and dark chocolate
s.how: Toss 150g macadamias, 100g chopped dried mango, 50g coconut chips and 100g dark chocolate chunks with a pinch of sea salt. Pack into bags for the bus ride across the desert.

m.note: Pepperberry kangaroo fillet with plum sauce and sweet potato
m.how: Rub 800g kangaroo fillet with 1 tsp ground pepperberry, garlic and oil. Roast 800g sweet potato wedges at 200C for 35 minutes. Sear the fillet hard to rare, rest 5 minutes and slice. Serve with warmed plum sauce.

w.note: Crisp pavlova with cream, passionfruit and strawberries
w.how: Whip 4 whites to soft peaks, add 220g caster sugar gradually until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Bake at 120C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 3 passionfruit and 250g strawberries.

d.note: Sparkling rosé with a raspberry in each flute
d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of sparkling rosé for three hours. Drop a raspberry into each of four flutes and pour slowly over the top so it fizzes up.

s.note: Golden hush puppies with hot sauce butter
s.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, a pinch of sugar, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and 200ml buttermilk and rest 10 minutes. Spoon into 175C oil and fry until golden. Melt 60g butter with 2 tbsp hot sauce to dip.

s.note: Thick toast spread with roasted garlic butter
s.how: Roast a head of garlic in foil at 180C for 40 minutes. Squeeze into 100g soft butter with parsley and salt and mash. Spread on 8 thick slices of white bread and toast at 200C until crisp at the edges.

m.note: Pork chops simmered in dark onion gravy, over rice
m.how: Season, flour and brown 4 thick pork chops. Make a dark roux with 40g butter and 3 tbsp flour, add 2 sliced onions, then 500ml stock and thyme. Simmer the chops in the gravy for 40 minutes. Serve over 300g long grain rice.

w.note: Silky spiced sweet potato pie in a buttery blind-baked crust
w.how: Roast 800g sweet potatoes until soft, peel and mash with 60g butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk, nutmeg and vanilla. Pour into a blind-baked case of 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and bake at 170C for 50 minutes.

d.note: Southern sweet tea over plenty of ice
d.how: Steep 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with a pinch of bicarb for 5 minutes. Stir in 100g sugar while hot, then cool. Pour over plenty of ice with lemon slices.

s.note: Soft egg and lettuce sandwiches on white bread
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Mash with 3 tbsp mayo, chives and white pepper. Spread on 8 slices soft white bread with shredded iceberg, close and cut into triangles.

s.note: Sheep's milk cheeses with honey, figs and crackers
s.how: Take 150g pecorino, 150g sheep's feta and 200g fresh ricotta out of the fridge an hour ahead. Arrange on a board with 4 halved figs, a drizzle of honey and crackers.

m.note: Beef shepherd's pie under golden buttery mash
m.how: Brown 750g beef mince hard. Add a diced onion and 2 carrots, then 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 250ml stock and simmer 40 minutes. Top with 1kg potatoes mashed with 60g butter, fork the top and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: Cinnamon apple crumble with hot custard
w.how: Stew 6 sliced apples with 60g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 10 minutes and tip into a dish. Rub 100g butter into 100g flour, then stir in 60g oats and 80g brown sugar. Scatter over and bake at 180C for 35 minutes. Serve with custard.

d.note: Cold farm milk, or a thick vanilla milkshake
d.how: Pour 1L cold full cream milk into four tall glasses. For a milkshake, blend each glass with a scoop of vanilla ice cream until thick and frothy. That'll do.

s.note: Little sandwiches, apple and cheese packed into a metal lunchbox
s.how: Make 4 small ham and cheddar sandwiches with 8 slices white bread, 100g ham and 100g cheddar, and cut into quarters. Slice 2 apples and toss in lemon. Pack into a metal lunchbox with 100g cheddar cubes and crackers, a different treasure in each corner.

s.note: Rice bubble treats cut into neat cubes and stacked into towers
s.how: Melt 60g butter with 250g marshmallows over low heat. Stir through 150g puffed rice until coated. Press into a lined tray and set for an hour. Cut into neat cubes and stack them into towers.

m.note: Pumpkin, lentil and coconut soup in mugs, with grilled cheese
m.how: Soften an onion with 1 tbsp grated ginger. Add 800g diced pumpkin, 150g red lentils, 400ml coconut milk and 600ml water and simmer 25 minutes, then blitz. Serve in big mugs with a straw, and grilled cheese made from 8 slices sourdough and 150g cheddar on the side.

w.note: Little golden sponge fingers filled with vanilla cream
w.how: Whisk 3 eggs with 100g sugar until pale and thick, then fold in 100g flour. Pipe 12 fingers onto a lined tray and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Cool, split and pipe in 200ml cream whipped with vanilla.

d.note: Blue raspberry soda with lime in tall cups
d.how: Fill four tall cups with ice. Add 40ml blue raspberry cordial to each, top with very cold soda water and squeeze in some lime. Add a straw and recline.

s.note: Salted edamame and sesame pickled cucumber, chopsticks only
s.how: Steam 400g edamame for 4 minutes and toss with flaky salt and sesame oil. Cut a cucumber into batons and pickle for 20 minutes in 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and sesame seeds. Serve both with chopsticks only.

s.note: Charred garlic broccolini stood up like a row of little trees
s.how: Blanch 2 bunches broccolini for 1 minute and drain. Char in a smoking pan with 2 sliced garlic cloves. Toss with 2 tbsp oyster sauce and a splash of sesame oil. Stand them up in a dish like trees.

m.note: Charred teriyaki chicken with rice and bok choy
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs for an hour in 60ml soy, 60ml mirin, 2 tbsp sake and 2 tbsp sugar. Grill skin side down until charred and cooked. Reduce the marinade to a glaze and brush over. Serve with 300g jasmine rice and bok choy.

w.note: Soft red bean mochi dusted in cornflour
w.how: Stir 200g glutinous rice flour, 60g sugar and 220ml water into a dough. Steam for 20 minutes, then knead smooth on a cornflour-dusted bench. Divide into 8, wrap each around a ball of red bean paste and dust with cornflour.

d.note: Sencha steeped gently and poured into small cups
d.how: Heat 1L water to about 80C, just off the boil and cooled a little. Steep 4 tsp sencha for 1 minute only, then pour into small cups. Refill the pot for a second round.

s.note: Warm damper with butter and golden syrup
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt. Mix in about 300ml milk with a knife, shape into a round and score the top. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve with butter and golden syrup.

s.note: Corned silverside sandwiches with hot mustard and pickles
s.how: Simmer a 1.2kg corned silverside with an onion, a carrot and peppercorns for 3 hours, then cool in the liquid. Slice thin onto 8 slices buttered white bread with English mustard and mustard pickles.

m.note: Lamb shoulder chop stew cooked low, with rosemary
m.how: Brown 1.2kg lamb shoulder chops in a heavy pot. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, 600g potatoes and 750ml stock with rosemary. Cover and simmer over coals or at 160C for 2.5 hours. Finish with chopped parsley.

w.note: Steamed currant pudding with golden syrup and custard
w.how: Rub 100g butter into 250g self-raising flour, stir in 75g sugar and 150g currants, then add 150ml milk to a soft dough. Wrap in a floured cloth or basin and steam for 2 hours. Serve with golden syrup and custard.

d.note: Billy tea in tin mugs with milk and sugar
d.how: Boil 1.2L water in a billy or pot. Throw in 3 tbsp loose leaf tea and a gum leaf if you have one, take it off the heat and swing it round to settle the leaves. Pour into tin mugs with milk and sugar.

s.note: Blistered pork crackling broken into shards
s.how: Score 600g pork rind, rub with flaky salt and dry uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 240C for 30 minutes until blistered and crisp all over. Cool for 5 minutes and break into pieces. Stay on the road.

s.note: Jammy scotch eggs with hot English mustard
s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel. Wrap each in 100g seasoned sausage mince. Roll in flour, 1 beaten egg and 100g panko. Fry at 170C for 7 minutes. Halve and serve with English mustard.

m.note: Lamb shepherd's pie under a golden mash crust
m.how: Brown 750g lamb mince. Add a diced onion and 2 carrots, then 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 250ml stock and simmer 40 minutes. Top with 1kg potatoes mashed with 60g butter and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.

w.note: Date pudding drowned in hot toffee sauce
w.how: Soak 200g chopped dates in 250ml boiling water with 1 tsp bicarb. Beat 80g butter with 150g brown sugar and 2 eggs, fold in 175g self-raising flour and the dates. Bake at 180C for 30 minutes. Simmer 100g butter, 150g brown sugar and 200ml cream for sauce.

d.note: English ale at cellar temperature in pint glasses
d.how: Leave four 500ml bottles of English ale out of the fridge for an hour so they're cool, not ice cold. Pour slowly into pint glasses and keep to the road, away from the moors.

s.note: Brown butter choc chip cookies with cold milk
s.how: Brown 150g butter and cool. Beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour, half a tsp bicarb and 200g choc chips. Rest overnight. Bake 16 cookies at 180C for 11 minutes. Serve with 1L cold milk.

s.note: Bocconcini snowmen with tomato hats and basil scarves
s.how: Stack 3 bocconcini on a skewer, about 300g in total, and top with half a cherry tomato as a hat. Press in cracked peppercorns for eyes and tie a basil leaf as a scarf. Drizzle with olive oil. Makes about 8.

m.note: Herb butter turkey breast with stuffing, potatoes and gravy
m.how: Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight. Roll with 60g butter mixed with chopped sage and roast at 170C until 70C inside, then rest 20 minutes. Bake a packet of stuffing alongside and roast 1kg potatoes. Make gravy with 300ml stock.

w.note: Gingerbread elves and trees iced red and green
w.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 100g golden syrup. Stir in 300g flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and half a tsp bicarb. Chill an hour, roll, cut into elves and trees and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Ice with 200g icing sugar in red and green.

d.note: Perfect cocoa with cinnamon and vanilla, never boiled
d.how: Whisk 4 tbsp cocoa, 4 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt with a splash of milk into a paste. Add 900ml milk, 100ml cream, a pinch of cinnamon and a drop of vanilla. Warm to drinking temperature without boiling and pour.

s.note: Rough chocolate chunks with half-dipped homemade honeycomb
s.how: Boil 150g sugar and 4 tbsp golden syrup to amber, whisk in 2 tsp bicarb and pour into a lined tin to set. Break into slabs and dip half in 100g melted dark chocolate. Serve with 100g milk chocolate broken into rough pieces.

s.note: Earl Grey shortbread with lemon zest
s.how: Grind 2 tsp Earl Grey tea leaves and beat into 200g butter with 80g icing sugar and lemon zest. Mix in 280g flour, roll into a log and chill an hour. Slice and bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Read the crumbs.

m.note: Beef braised in dark ale with bread and butter
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 carrots with thyme. Add 375ml ale and 400ml stock, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Serve with crusty bread and butter.

w.note: Brown sugar date pudding with toffee sauce and cream
w.how: Soak 200g chopped dates in 250ml boiling water with 1 tsp bicarb. Beat 80g butter with 150g brown sugar and 2 eggs, fold in 175g self-raising flour and the dates. Bake at 180C for 30 minutes. Pour over sauce of 100g butter, 150g brown sugar and 200ml cream.

d.note: Dark hot chocolate with brown sugar and cream
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, a pinch of salt and a spoon of brown sugar. Pour into four mugs and top with 100ml softly whipped cream.

s.note: Brie, cheddar and blue with grapes, honey and walnuts
s.how: Take 150g brie, 150g aged cheddar and 100g blue cheese out an hour ahead. Toast 80g walnuts at 170C for 8 minutes. Arrange with grapes and crackers and drizzle honey over the blue.

s.note: Iced cinnamon scrolls from a proper home bakery
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 250ml warm milk and 50g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 60g butter, 80g brown sugar and 1 tbsp cinnamon. Roll, cut 12 and prove 30 minutes. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes and ice with 100g cream cheese beaten with icing sugar.

m.note: Rigatoni in chilli tomato sauce with torn burrata
m.how: Simmer 2 tins crushed tomatoes with 3 sliced garlic cloves and chilli flakes for 20 minutes. Cook 500g rigatoni 2 minutes short and finish it in the sauce. Tear 2 burrata over the top with basil just before serving.

w.note: Vanilla bean cupcakes with a tall pink meringue buttercream swirl
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar and vanilla bean seeds, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 170C for 18 minutes. Whisk 2 whites and 120g sugar over hot water, beat in 200g butter, tint pale pink and pipe tall. Add a fondant flower.

d.note: Champagne in flutes with a raspberry in each
d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of champagne in an ice bucket for 30 minutes. Drop a raspberry into each of four flutes and pour slowly over the top.

s.note: Little squares of thin cheese pizza, all for you
s.how: Simmer a tin of crushed tomatoes with a garlic clove and oregano for 10 minutes. Stretch 500g pizza dough thin, spread with sauce and cover with 250g mozzarella. Bake on a hot tray at the oven's highest heat for 6 minutes and cut into small squares.

s.note: Buttery popcorn, half coated red, served in clean paint tins
s.how: Pop 120g kernels and toss half with 30g melted butter and salt. Melt 150g white chocolate with red colouring and toss through the other half, then let it set. Mix both together and serve in clean paint tins.

m.note: Baked sharp cheddar mac and cheese with a crumb top
m.how: Cook 400g macaroni 2 minutes short. Melt 50g butter, stir in 3 tbsp flour, whisk in 750ml milk until thick, then add 250g grated cheddar and 1 tsp mustard. Fold through, top with 50g breadcrumbs and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

w.note: Iced star and tree sugar cookies with silver cachous
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Roll out, cut into stars and trees and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Ice with 300g icing sugar, some tinted green, and add silver cachous.

d.note: Ice-cold milk, or a chocolate milkshake
d.how: Pour 1L ice-cold full cream milk into four tall glasses. For milkshakes, blend each with a spoon of cocoa, a spoon of sugar and a few ice cubes until frothy.

s.note: Green chocolate witch fingers with almond nails
s.how: Melt 200g white chocolate and tint it green. Dip 20 pretzel rods most of the way, then press a flaked almond on the tip of each as a nail. Lay on baking paper to set.

s.note: Cheese board with fig jam and an olive eye in the middle
s.how: Arrange 150g brie, 150g aged cheddar and 100g blue on a board with lavash, a bowl of fig jam and grapes. Put a single stuffed olive right in the middle as the eye.

m.note: Spiced lamb and pumpkin stew with couscous in a black pot
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced lamb shoulder. Soften 2 onions with 2 tsp cumin and 1 tsp cinnamon, add 500ml stock and a tin of tomatoes. Braise at 160C for 2.5 hours, adding 600g pumpkin for the last hour. Serve over 300g couscous.

w.note: Glossy red candy apples on sticks
w.how: Push sticks into 4 apples. Boil 400g sugar, 125ml water and 2 tbsp golden syrup to 150C, add red colouring and dip and twirl each apple. Set on oiled baking paper until hard.

d.note: Frothing lime sorbet punch with gummy worms
d.how: Scoop 500ml lime sorbet into a punch bowl. Pour over 1L lemonade and 250ml pineapple juice so it froths up. Hang a few gummy worms over the side of the bowl.

s.note: Dark chocolate truffles rolled in cocoa, nuts or sprinkles
s.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate with 20g butter. Stir smooth and chill 3 hours. Scoop and roll into balls and coat in cocoa, crushed peanuts or sprinkles.

s.note: Crisp golden cheddar coins with paprika
s.how: Rub 80g butter into 150g flour, add 150g grated cheddar, a pinch of smoked paprika and cayenne, and bring together. Roll into a log and chill an hour. Slice into coins and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden.

m.note: Sausage and mushroom pizza on a thin crust
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with 200g crushed tomatoes mixed with garlic and oregano. Top with crumbled sausage from 3 Italian sausages, 150g sliced mushrooms and 250g mozzarella. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.

w.note: Chocolate loaf hollowed and filled with gold coins
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 150g butter, whisk in 3 eggs and 150g sugar and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes. Cut off the top, hollow out, fill with chocolate coins, replace the lid and cover in ganache of 100g chocolate and 100ml cream.

d.note: Root beer floats foaming to the top
d.how: Put two scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Pour a 375ml can of root beer slowly over each until it foams to the top. Serve with long spoons.

s.note: Buttery mash in a big bowl, po-tay-toes the proper way
s.how: Boil 1kg floury potatoes until soft. Mash with 80g butter, 150ml hot milk and fine salt until smooth. Pile into a big bowl and scatter with chives. Boil them, mash them, and leave the stew for later.

s.note: Honey oatcakes with sharp cheese and apples
s.how: Melt 60g butter with 2 tbsp honey and stir into 200g rolled oats with a pinch of salt. Press thin into a lined tray and bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Cut while warm. Serve with 200g sharp cheddar and sliced apples.

m.note: Rabbit or chicken stew with ale, thyme and potatoes
m.how: Brown 1kg rabbit pieces or chicken thighs. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots and thyme, then 200ml ale and 500ml stock and 600g potatoes. Simmer covered for 90 minutes until tender.

w.note: Golden honey cake with toasted almonds
w.how: Melt 150g honey, 125g butter and 80g brown sugar. Cool, beat in 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake at 160C for 45 minutes. Brush with warm honey and scatter with 30g toasted flaked almonds.

d.note: Warm honey apple drink, or real mead
d.how: Warm 1L cloudy apple juice with 3 tbsp honey, a cinnamon stick and 4 cloves for 10 minutes. Strain into mugs. For the grown-ups, pour a glass of real mead instead.

s.note: Jammy onion dip with thick ridged chips
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter for 40 minutes until deep and jammy, then cool and chop. Fold into 200g sour cream and 100g cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives. Serve with a big bag of ridged potato chips.

s.note: Warm glazed and cinnamon sugar cake doughnuts
s.how: Warm 8 cake doughnuts at 160C for 2 minutes. Dip four in a glaze of 150g icing sugar, 2 tbsp milk and vanilla. Toss the rest in sugar mixed with cinnamon. Hand them out like the cops are in on it.

m.note: Double smashed cheeseburgers with pickles and mustard
m.how: Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls and smash thin on a smoking griddle. Flip after 90 seconds, add American cheese and stack two per soft bun with pickles, onion and mustard.

w.note: Glossy fudgy brownies with a soft middle
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 3 eggs with 250g sugar until glossy, fold in the chocolate, 80g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes so the middle stays fudgy. Cool before cutting.

d.note: Pineapple orange punch, nothing extra from the laundry
d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a big bowl with lots of ice. Top with 750ml lemonade and add sliced oranges. Ladle into cups.

s.note: Smoked salmon blini and tomato bruschetta on silver trays
s.how: Top 12 blinis with crème fraîche and 100g smoked salmon. Toast 12 baguette slices, rub with garlic and top with 2 diced tomatoes and basil. Arrange both on silver trays.

s.note: Buttered toast soldiers with soft-boiled eggs
s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes. Toast 4 thick slices white bread golden, butter and cut into soldiers. Put each egg in a cup, take the top off and dip away.

m.note: Hearty beef and potato stew with crusty bread
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 carrots, add 600g potatoes, 750ml stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until the meat falls apart. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Steamed brandy fruit pudding flamed at the table
w.how: Soak 500g dried fruit in 100ml brandy overnight. Mix with 125g butter, 125g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 100g breadcrumbs, 75g flour and 2 tsp mixed spice. Steam 4 hours. Warm 2 tbsp brandy, light it and pour over at the table. Serve with custard.

d.note: Homemade eggnog with brandy and nutmeg
d.how: Whisk 4 yolks with 80g sugar. Pour over 500ml hot milk and 200ml cream, then stir over low heat to 75C. Chill well, stir in 100ml brandy and grate fresh nutmeg on top.

s.note: Pastry fingers with almond nails and scored knuckles
s.how: Rub 100g butter into 200g flour, then add 1 egg to a dough. Roll into 16 finger shapes, press a flaked almond in the tip of each and score knuckles with a knife. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes.

s.note: Curled beetroot crisps like dark rose petals
s.how: Slice 3 beetroots paper thin on a mandoline. Toss with 2 tbsp olive oil and spread on lined trays. Bake at 150C for 25 minutes until curled and crisp, then sprinkle with flaky salt.

m.note: Rib roast carved at the table with potatoes and horseradish
m.how: Season a 2kg beef rib roast with salt, garlic and rosemary overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 160C until 52C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Carve at the candlelit table with horseradish.

w.note: Kirsch chocolate sponge with cream, cherries and shaved chocolate
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick, then fold in 120g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 175C for 25 minutes and split. Brush with syrup and 3 tbsp kirsch. Layer with 400ml whipped cream and morello cherries. Shave dark chocolate on top.

d.note: Sharp fresh lemonade, made by Wednesday herself
d.how: Dissolve 120g sugar in 120ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water. Pour over ice with sliced lemon. Is it made from real lemons? Yes.

s.note: Blistered flatbreads brushed with butter and za'atar
s.how: Mix 300g flour, 7g yeast, 150g Greek yoghurt and 100ml warm water and rest an hour. Roll into 6 rounds and cook on a smoking pan until puffed and blistered. Brush with 50g butter mixed with 2 tbsp za'atar.

s.note: Medjool dates stuffed with orange pistachio cream cheese
s.how: Split 12 medjool dates and remove the stones. Mix 100g cream cheese with orange zest and 40g chopped pistachios. Fill each date and dust with cinnamon.

m.note: Charred spiced yoghurt chicken with saffron rice
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs overnight in 150g yoghurt, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp each cumin, coriander and turmeric and lemon juice. Skewer and grill hot until charred. Cook 300g basmati with a pinch of saffron. Serve with garlic sauce and pickles.

w.note: Walnut pistachio baklava in honey orange blossom syrup
w.how: Mix 200g walnuts and 100g pistachios, chopped, with 1 tsp cinnamon and 50g sugar. Layer 12 sheets filo brushed with 150g butter with the nuts between. Cut into diamonds and bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Pour over 200g hot honey with 1 tbsp orange blossom water.

d.note: Frothy blended mint lemonade, as cool as a magic lamp wish
d.how: Blend the juice of 5 lemons with a big handful of mint, 120ml sugar syrup made from 120g sugar, 750ml cold water and 2 cups of ice until frothy. Strain into four glasses.

s.note: Steamed beef momo with tomato chilli achar
s.how: Mix 400g beef mince with a grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger and chopped coriander. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers and steam for 10 minutes. Blitz 3 roasted tomatoes with a chilli and garlic for achar.

s.note: Cucumber and smoked salmon fingers on a silver tray
s.how: Spread 8 slices white bread with 150g cream cheese. Fill half with thin cucumber and half with 150g smoked salmon and dill. Cut off the crusts and cut into neat fingers. Lay them on a silver tray.

m.note: Beef rib roast with Yorkshires, potatoes and gravy
m.how: Season a 2kg beef rib roast overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C inside and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C for 20 minutes. Make gravy with 400ml stock.

w.note: Dark chocolate layer cake under glossy ganache, one candle
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Layer and cover with 150g chocolate melted with 150ml cream. Add a single candle.

d.note: Breakfast tea from a warmed pot into fine china
d.how: Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 4 tea bags and 1L freshly boiled water and brew 4 minutes. Serve on a tray with milk and sugar, poured into fine china.

s.note: A smuggled stash of chips, pretzels and chocolate peanuts
s.how: Toss a bag of ridged potato chips, 150g pretzels and 150g chocolate-coated peanuts together in a big bowl. Put 200g mixed lollies in a smaller bowl next to it, like a stash you'd smuggle into detention.

s.note: Chunky guacamole with an olive jewel and plantain chips
s.how: Roughly smash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes, chopped coriander, a jalapeño and red onion. Season well. Sit one whole green olive in the middle like the jewel. Serve with plantain chips.

m.note: Thai red chicken curry with lemongrass and lime leaf
m.how: Fry 3 tbsp red curry paste in the thick top of 400ml coconut milk until fragrant. Add 800g sliced chicken thighs, the rest of the coconut milk, a bruised lemongrass stalk, torn lime leaves, fish sauce and palm sugar. Simmer 20 minutes. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.note: Dark chocolate layer cake with glossy ganache, eat with care
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Layer and cover with 150g chocolate melted with 150ml cream.

d.note: Pineapple, mango and passionfruit with lime and soda
d.how: Mix 400ml pineapple juice, 400ml mango nectar, the pulp of 3 passionfruit and the juice of a lime. Pour over crushed ice in four glasses and top with soda water.

s.note: Rainbow rows of fruit with lime honey drizzle
s.how: Cut a quarter watermelon, a quarter rockmelon, 2 kiwifruit and a quarter pineapple into chunks. Arrange in rainbow rows with 125g blueberries. Drizzle with the juice of a lime mixed with honey.

s.note: Glittering fairy bread triangles dusted with a little edible glitter
s.how: Spread 8 slices white bread with soft butter right to the edges. Press face down into hundreds and thousands, then dust with a little edible glitter. Trim the crusts and cut into triangles.

m.note: Spatchcock paprika chicken with corn and potatoes, eaten by hand
m.how: Spatchcock a 1.8kg chicken and rub with 3 garlic cloves, lemon zest and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Roast at 220C for 45 minutes with 800g potatoes. Grill 4 corn cobs. Pile it all in the middle and eat with your hands. Bangarang.

w.note: Green pandan sponge with a chocolate clock face
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick, then fold in 150g self-raising flour, 60g melted butter and 1 tsp pandan extract. Bake at 175C for 30 minutes. Cover in 150g butter beaten with 300g icing sugar and pandan. Pipe a clock face in 50g melted dark chocolate.

d.note: Shimmering lime lemonade with a swirl of edible glitter
d.how: Pour 1.25L cold lemonade into a jug with the juice of a lime. Stir in a pinch of edible glitter so it shimmers and swirls. Pour into four glasses straight away.

s.note: A vase-style bouquet of vegetables with green goddess dip
s.how: Cut radishes into roses, peel carrots into ribbons and slice a cucumber and baby capsicums. Arrange in a vase like flowers. Blitz 200g sour cream with parsley, chives and lemon for the dip.

s.note: Hard-shell beef tacos with capsicum tongues
s.how: Brown 400g beef mince with taco spices. Fill 12 small taco shells with the mince, shredded iceberg and 100g cheddar. Hang a strip of red capsicum out of each like a tongue.

m.note: Spaghetti and meatballs in slow tomato sauce
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 2 slices soaked bread, 40g parmesan and parsley. Roll into balls and brown. Simmer 40 minutes in 2 tins crushed tomatoes. Toss with 500g spaghetti and more parmesan.

w.note: Deep green cupcakes with cream cheese frosting and red lips
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour, 1 tbsp cocoa, 125ml buttermilk and green colouring. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes. Frost with 200g cream cheese beaten with 200g icing sugar and add a line of red sugar.

d.note: Frothy green lime sorbet punch with lemonade and pineapple
d.how: Scoop 500ml lime sorbet into a jug. Pour over 1L lemonade and 200ml pineapple juice and stir gently so it froths up green. Pour into four glasses.

s.note: Little meringue ghosts with choc chip eyes
s.how: Whisk 3 egg whites with a pinch of cream of tartar, then add 180g caster sugar a spoon at a time until stiff and glossy. Pipe tall teardrop ghosts and press in 2 mini choc chips each for eyes. Bake at 100C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven.

s.note: Buttery toasted rolls packed with lemony lobster
s.how: Chop 300g cooked lobster or prawn meat and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, a finely diced celery stick and chives. Butter and toast 4 split hot dog buns and pile the filling in.

m.note: Clam chowder in hollowed toasted bread bowls
m.how: Steam 1kg clams open and strain the liquid. Render 150g bacon, add an onion, 2 celery sticks and 500g diced potato. Add the clam liquid and 500ml milk and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream and the clams. Ladle into 4 hollowed, toasted cob loaves.

w.note: Lattice blueberry pie with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 750g blueberries with 150g sugar, lemon zest and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and cool 3 hours. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: White hot chocolate with mini marshmallows
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped white chocolate and a little vanilla until frothy. Pour into four mugs and top with mini marshmallows. Can I keep you?
